one child passenger died after they evacuatedthe airplane. The airplane sustained substantialdamage. The airplane was being operated as ascheduled international passenger commuterflight from Hollywood International Airport,
Florida, to MYAT. Visual meteorological
conditions prevailed for the flight, which
operated on a visual flight rules flight plan.
The National Transportation Safety Board
determines that the probable cause of this
accident was the in-flight failure of the right
engine and the pilots failure to adequately
manage the airplanes performance after
the engine failed. The right engine failure
resulted from inadequate maintenance that
was performed by Air Sunshines maintenancepersonnel.
story-koala-067.audioTextZh:
2003年7月13日，阳光航空的一架塞斯纳飞机在右发动机空中失效后，迫降在了大西洋中。九名乘客中有四人没有受伤，三名乘客和飞行员受了轻伤，一名成年乘客和一名儿童乘客在撤离飞机后死亡。这架飞机受到了严重损坏。

这架飞机当时执飞的是从佛罗里达州好莱坞国际机场飞往MYAT的定期国际通勤客运航班。此次飞行时的气象条件为目视气象条件，且是按照目视飞行规则飞行计划执行的飞行任务。

美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是右发动机空中失效，以及发动机失效后飞行员未能妥善管理飞机的性能。右发动机的失效是由阳光航空公司的维修人员进行的不当维护导致的。

story-koala-068.audioText:
On November 22， 2004， a Gulf-stream airlinesaircraft struck a light pole and crashed about
3 miles southwest of Hobby Airport, Houston,Texas, while on an instrument landing systemapproach to runway 4. The two pilots and theflight attendant were killed, an individual in a
vehicle near the airport received minor injuries,and the airplane was destroyed by impact
forces. The airplane was being operated on aninstrument flight rules flight plan. Instrumentmeteorological conditions (IMC) prevailed at
the time of the accident.
The accident flight was scheduled to depart
from Dallas Airport. The flight crew planned
to pick up former President George Bush andother passengers at Houston. The flight was
scheduled to depart HOU about 0654.
The flight departed Dallas Airport about 0530，the departure was delayed because of poor
weather conditions at DAL. The captain was
the flying pilot, and the first officer performedthe non-flying pilot duties.
Before flight the flight crew received ATIS
information Quebec, which reported that the
winds were calm, the visibility was low in fog,
and the clouds were broken at 100 feet and
overcast at 9,000 feet.
story-koala-068.audioTextZh: 2004年11月22日，一架湾流航空飞机在对得克萨斯州休斯敦霍比机场4跑道实施仪表着陆系统进近时撞上灯杆，并在机场西南约3海里处坠毁。2名飞行员和1名乘务员遇难，机场附近一辆车内的1人受轻伤，飞机因撞击损毁。该机按仪表飞行规则飞行计划运行，事故发生时为仪表气象条件。事故航班原计划从达拉斯机场起飞，机组准备到休斯敦接前总统乔治·布什及其他乘客，计划约06时54分从HOU离场。航班约05时30分从达拉斯机场起飞；由于DAL天气恶劣，离场延误。机长担任操纵飞行员，副驾驶履行非操纵飞行员职责。飞行前，机组收到自动终端情报服务Quebec通播：静风，雾中能见度低，100英尺多云，9000英尺阴天。

story-koala-069.audioText:
On March 23 1994 the aircraft named Glinka,after the father of Russian music, was flying
from Moscow to Hong Kong. There were sixty-three passengers with twelve crew memberson board.
The aircraft crashed after a captain allowed
his child to manipulate the controls of the
plane. The pilot's 11 year old daughter and 16year old son were taking turns in the pilot's
seat. While the boy was flying, the captain
inadvertently disengaged the autopilot linkageto the ailerons and put the airliner in a bank
of 90 degrees which caused the nose to dropsharply.
The co-pilot pulled back on the yoke to obtainlevel flight but the plane stalled. With his seatpulled all the way back, the co-pilot in the
right hand seat could not properly control theaircraft. After several stalls and rapid pull-upsthe plane went into a spiral descent. In the
end, the co-pilot initiated a pull-up and nearlyregained a stable flight path but the aircraftstruck the ground in an almost level attitudekilling all 75 aboard.
story-koala-069.audioTextZh:
1994年3月23日，一架以俄罗斯音乐之父格林卡命名的飞机，正从莫斯科飞往香港。机上载有63名乘客和12名机组人员。

这架飞机坠毁的原因是机长允许自己的孩子操控飞机。当时，这位飞行员11岁的女儿和16岁的儿子在轮流坐在飞行员座位上。当男孩在操作飞行时，机长无意间断开了自动驾驶仪与副翼的连接装置，使这架客机倾斜了90度，导致机头急剧下坠。

副驾驶拉动操纵杆试图使飞机恢复水平飞行状态，但飞机却失速了。由于副驾驶右侧座位的座椅被拉到了最后面，他无法有效地操控飞机。在经历了几次失速和快速拉起机头的操作后，飞机进入了螺旋式下降状态。最后，副驾驶再次拉起机头，几乎恢复了稳定的飞行路径，但飞机几乎是以水平姿态撞击到了地面，机上75人全部遇难。

story-koala-070.audioText:
On June 10 1990 there was a flight from
Birmingham, England to Malaga, Spain, whenthe aircraft was flying at FL 173, a large sectionof windshield fell away from the aircraft. The
decompression pulled the captain out from
under his seatbelt. Despite trying to hold ontothe yoke, the captain was sucked out into theopening. He was in an immediate danger.
A steward in the cockpit was fortunately ableto grab hold of his legs. Another steward wasable to strap him into the vacant seat and aidin holding onto the captain's legs. The copilotwearing full restraints made an emergency
landing at Southampton.
The captain remained half way out of the
aircraft for 15 minutes and suffered only
frostbite and some fractures. Improper bolts
used to replace the windshield two days earlierresulted in the accident.
story-koala-070.audioTextZh: 1990年6月10日，一架飞机执行从英国伯明翰飞往西班牙马拉加的航班。当飞机飞至FL173时，大块风挡玻璃从机体脱落。快速失压把机长从安全带下方拽出；尽管他试图抓住驾驶盘，仍被吸出风挡开口，立即陷入危险。幸运的是，驾驶舱内一名乘务员抓住了机长的双腿。另一名乘务员把自己固定在空座椅上，协助抓住机长双腿。全程系好安全带的副驾驶操纵飞机在南安普敦紧急着陆。机长有一半身体悬在飞机外长达15分钟，最终只受到冻伤和几处骨折。事故原因是两天前更换风挡玻璃时使用了不合适的螺栓。

story-koala-071.audioText:
On August 14， 2005 at approximately 12：00p.m local Greek time, a Boeing 737-300，
crashed into rolling terrain northeast of
Athens, Greece. The aircraft had departed
Larnaka Airport, Cyprus, two hours and 57
minutes prior to the accident.
According to the investigation, during
climb-out as the aircraft passed 12,000 feet,the cabin altitude warning horn sounded. Thecaptain then began radio communications
with his company maintenance base at
Larnaka. The aircraft was on autopilot at thetime and followed its FMCS inserted route. Itsubsequently entered the missed approach
holding pattern.
Two Air Force F-16 fighter aircraft interceptedthe aircraft emergency call and one of the
pilots noticed that the captain's seat was
empty and the first officer's seat was occupiedby an incapacitated person. Shortly thereafter,one person was seen to enter the cockpit
wearing an oxygen mask.
After 1 hour and 12 minutes in the holding
pattern the left engine flamed out due to
fuel starvation and 10 minutes later the rightengine also flamed out. The cabin altitude
warning horn subsequently stopped soundingafter the aircraft later descended below 10,000feet during its final descent.
Greek authorities suggested the failure of
pressurization in the aircraft may have causedthe crash when they ruled out a terrorist
attack.
story-koala-071.audioTextZh:
2005年8月14日，当地希腊时间大约中午12点，一架波音737-300型飞机坠毁在希腊雅典东北部的起伏地形中。在事故发生前两小时57分钟，这架飞机从塞浦路斯拉纳卡机场起飞。

根据调查，在飞机爬升过程中，当高度超过12000英尺时，客舱高度警告喇叭响起。随后机长开始与位于拉纳卡的公司维修基地进行无线电通讯。当时飞机处于自动驾驶状态，并按照飞行管理计算机系统（FMCS）设定的航线飞行。随后，飞机进入了复飞等待航线。

两架希腊空军的F-16战斗机接到了这架飞机的紧急呼叫并进行了拦截，其中一名飞行员注意到机长座位上空无一人，而副驾驶座位上坐着一名失去行动能力的人。不久之后，有人看到一个戴着氧气面罩的人进入了驾驶舱。

在等待航线上飞行了1小时12分钟后，由于燃油耗尽，左发动机熄火，10分钟后，右发动机也熄火了。在飞机最后下降阶段高度降至10000英尺以下后，客舱高度警告喇叭随后停止了鸣响。

希腊当局在排除了恐怖袭击的可能性后指出，飞机的增压系统故障可能是导致此次坠机事故的原因。

story-koala-072.audioText:
The flight departed Peachtree Airport,
moments later the pilot radioed that the
airplane had a landing gear problem, and
there was smoke in the cockpit. The pilot wasinstructed to enter visual traffic for Runway 2R.Once the airplane was in the traffic pattern, thecontroller told the pilot that it appeared that
the landing gear was extended, and cleared
the flight to land. As the airplane neared
touchdown the controller told the pilot that
the landing gear was not down and locked, andthen instructed the pilot to go around. As thepilot maneuvered the airplane for a landing onrunway 27, the pilot was again instructed to
go around. Seconds later the aircraft toucheddown in a grassy area the approach ends of
runways 2R.
Examination of the airplane disclosed that theairplane had sustained extensive fire damage
to the floor area beneath the pilot's seat. Theexamination revealed that a flex hydraulic fluidsupply line was missing, and there had been
electrical arcing in the immediate vicinity of thehot spot.
The National Transportation Safety Board
determines the probable cause(s)of this
accident as follows: The failure of the flex
hydraulic line and the chaffing of an electrical
line under the pilot seat that resulted in an
in-flight fire.
story-koala-072.audioTextZh:
这架航班从皮茨特里机场起飞，没过多久，飞行员通过无线电报告称飞机的起落架出现问题，并且驾驶舱内有烟雾。飞行员接到指令，进入2R跑道的目视起落航线。

一旦飞机进入起落航线，管制员告诉飞行员，看起来起落架已经放下了，并批准该航班降落。当飞机接近着陆时，管制员又告诉飞行员，起落架没有放下并锁定，随后指示飞行员进行复飞。当飞行员操控飞机准备在27号跑道降落时，又一次接到了复飞指令。几秒钟后，飞机降落在了2R跑道进近端的一片草地上。

对飞机进行检查后发现，飞机驾驶座下方的地板区域遭受了大面积火灾损坏。检查结果显示，一根柔性液压供油管不见了，而且在起火点附近存在电气电弧现象。

美国国家运输安全委员会认定这起事故的可能原因如下：柔性液压管路故障，以及驾驶座下方的电线磨损，导致了飞行过程中起火。

story-koala-073.audioText:
On 18 August 2006， a Boeing 747aircraft,
with a crew of 18 and 243 passengers departedHong Kong, China, on a scheduled passengerservice to Melbourne, Australia.
While in cruise, one of the cabin crew notifiedthe flight crew that there was a smell of fuel inthe first class cabin. One of the pilots verifiedthe fuel smell and then proceeded to inspectthe engines from the cabin windows.
A fluid trail was evident from the rear of the
number-3 engine. During this time, it was
noted by the other pilots that the number-3engine had a higher than normal fuel flow. Theflight crew conducted an in-flight shut downof the number-3 engine and diverted the
aircraft to Darwin.
A subsequent inspection of the number-3
engine revealed the fuel manifold return line
had fractured, causing a fuel leak. The fuel linewas replaced and the aircraft was returned toservice.
In 2005, the ATSB investigated two other fuelmanifold return line fractures, from the sameengine type, under similar circumstances.
story-koala-073.audioTextZh:
2006年8月18日，一架载有18名机组人员和243名乘客的波音747飞机从中国香港出发，执行飞往澳大利亚墨尔本的定期客运航班。

在巡航过程中，一名客舱乘务员通知飞行机组，头等舱内有燃油味。一名飞行员确认了燃油味，然后从客舱窗户检查发动机。可以明显看到3号发动机后部有液体痕迹。在此期间，其他飞行员注意到3号发动机的燃油流量高于正常水平。飞行机组在飞行中关闭了3号发动机，并将飞机转向达尔文。

随后对3号发动机的检查显示，燃油总管回油管路断裂，导致燃油泄漏。燃油管路被更换后，飞机恢复了服务。

2005年，澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）曾对另外两起相同发动机型号在类似情况下发生的燃油总管回油管路断裂事件进行过调查。

story-koala-074.audioText:
On 18 January 2005, a Beech aircraft
sustained damage when its main landing gearcollapsed during touchdown on runway 24 atPerth Airport, WA.
The aircraft had earlier departed the
aerodrome on a charter flight with one pilot
and seven passengers on board. Shortly
after takeoff, the pilot selected the landing
gear up and subsequently observed that the
red gear-in-transit warning light remained
illuminated. An aerodrome controller noticedthat the aircrafts landing gear did not retract
and passed that information to the departurescontroller. The departures controller cleared
the pilot to climb to 4,000 ft and provided
radar vectors to a suitable area where the pilotcould complete troubleshooting of the aircraftsystems.
The pilot completed the checklist actions in anattempt to manually extend the landing gear.However, the green gear down indicator lightsdid not illuminate
The pilot returned to Perth Airport and
conducted a fly-past of the aerodrome controltower and maintenance facility at an altitude
of about 500 ft. Engineer and air traffic controlwitnesses to that flypast indicated to the pilotthat the landing gear appeared to be in the
extended position.
During the subsequent landing, the right mainlanding gear collapsed and retracted into thewheel well. The left main landing gear partiallyretracted into the wheel well and the nose gearremained extended. The right engine nacellefuel tank was punctured, requiring removal
of the remaining fuel in that tank prior to theaircrafts removal from the runway.
story-koala-074.audioTextZh:
2005年1月18日，一架比奇飞机在西澳大利亚州珀斯机场的24号跑道着陆时，主起落架坍塌，导致飞机受损。

这架飞机早些时候从该机场起飞执行包机任务，机上有一名飞行员和七名乘客。起飞后不久，飞行员选择收起起落架，随后发现起落架转换状态红色警告灯一直亮着。一名机场管制员注意到飞机的起落架没有收起，并将这一信息传达给了离场管制员。离场管制员批准飞行员爬升至4000英尺，并通过雷达引导飞机前往一个合适的区域，以便飞行员能够对飞机系统进行故障排查。

飞行员完成了检查单上的操作步骤，试图手动放下起落架。然而，起落架放下的绿色指示灯并未亮起。

飞行员返回珀斯机场，以大约500英尺的高度从机场控制塔和维修设施上空低空飞过。目睹此次低空飞过的工程师和空中交通管制人员向飞行员表示，起落架看起来处于放下状态。

在随后的着陆过程中，右主起落架坍塌并缩回到轮舱内。左主起落架部分缩回到轮舱内，前起落架则保持放下状态。右发动机短舱燃油箱被刺穿，在将飞机从跑道上移走之前，需要先将该油箱内剩余的燃油抽出。

story-koala-075.audioText:
The Scott Aviation aircraft with two crew
members and four passengers on board,
took off from Montréal, Quebec, for a night
instrument flight rules flight to Bromont,
Quebec.
Upon approaching Bromont, the co-pilot
activated the lighting system and contacted
the approach. The flight crew was advised
that the runway edge lights were out of order.However, the approach lights and the visual
approach slope indicator did turn on.
The flight crew executed the approach, and
the aircraft touched down at 300 feet to theleft of Runway 05L and 1800 feet beyond
the threshold. It continued on its course for
a distance of approximately 1800 feet beforecoming to a stop in a ditch. The crew tried tostop the engines, but the left engine did notstop.
The co-pilot entered the cabin to direct the
evacuation. One of the passengers tried
to open the emergency exit door, but was
unsuccessful. All of the aircraft's occupants
exited through the main entrance door. Bothpilots and one passenger sustained serious
injuries, and the three remaining passengersreceived minor injuries. The aircraft suffered
major damage
story-koala-075.audioTextZh:
一架斯科特航空公司的飞机搭载着两名机组人员和四名乘客，从魁北克省的蒙特利尔起飞，执行一次夜间仪表飞行规则的航班，目的地是魁北克省的布罗蒙。

在接近布罗蒙时，副驾驶启动了照明系统并联系了进近管制。机组人员被告知跑道边灯出现故障。不过，进近灯光和目视进近坡度指示系统（VASI）确实亮着。

机组人员执行了进近程序，飞机在05L跑道左侧300英尺处、跑道入口外1800英尺的位置着陆。飞机继续沿着其航线飞行了大约1800英尺，最终停在了一条沟渠里。机组人员试图关闭发动机，但左发动机没有停下来。

副驾驶进入客舱指挥撤离。其中一名乘客试图打开紧急出口门，但没有成功。机上所有人员都通过主入口门撤离了飞机。两名飞行员和一名乘客受了重伤，其余三名乘客受了轻伤。这架飞机遭受了严重损坏。

story-koala-076.audioText:
A witness reported that he observed the
aircraft taxi to the eastern end of the runwayand commence the take-off roll but lost sightof the aircraft as it moved along the runway.
The pilot stated that the take-off roll was froma rolling start with power being slowly applieduntil engine output stabilized. At about 90
kts indicated air speed, the pilot attempted torotate the aircraft but encountered resistanceto rearward movement of the control column.He decided to reject the takeoff because
the aircraft speed at the time was below his
nominated decision speed of 100 kts. The pilotreported that he then reduced the engine
power to idle and applied maximum braking.
The aircraft overran the runway, passed
through the airport boundary fence, continuedacross a public road, and passed through
another fence before coming to a stop 162 mbeyond the end of the runway. An inspectionof the runway revealed a skid mark from the
aircrafts right tire, which commenced 65 m
before the end of the runway.
After the aircraft came to a stop, the pilot
exited the aircraft via the crew door, assistedthe passengers to evacuate the aircraft
through the rear cabin door and marshalled
them to an area away from the aircraft. A
passenger then used a mobile phone to
contact emergency services, who attended thescene soon after.
story-koala-076.audioTextZh:
一名目击者报告，他看到飞机滑行到跑道东端并开始起飞滑跑，但随着飞机沿跑道前进，他随后看不到飞机了。

飞行员称，飞机以滚动方式开始起飞滑跑，并缓慢增加功率，直到发动机输出稳定。在指示空速约90节时，飞行员尝试抬前轮，但发现操纵杆向后移动时受到阻力。由于当时速度仍低于其设定的100节决断速度，他决定中断起飞。飞行员随后将发动机功率收至慢车，并实施最大刹车。

飞机冲出跑道，穿过机场边界围栏，又越过一条公共道路并穿过另一道围栏，最终停在跑道末端外162米处。对跑道的检查发现了飞机右轮留下的刹车痕迹，该痕迹从距跑道末端65米处开始。

飞机停下后，飞行员经机组舱门离开飞机，协助乘客从后客舱门撤离，并将他们引导至远离飞机的区域。一名乘客随后用手机联系应急服务部门，应急人员很快赶到现场。

story-koala-077.audioText:
A Boeing 737-200 was scheduled to operatea regular public transport flight from Hobartto Sydney on 17 May 2005 departing at 0600Eastern Standard Time with 6 crew membersand 26 passengers.
During the starting of the right engine, the
aircraft dispatcher informed the flight crew
that there was smoke and sparks shooting
from the right engine and advised to get
everyone off. The pilot in command called foran emergency evacuation without initiating
the Passenger Evacuation Checklist. As a
result, the wing flaps were not set to the
extended position and the tail section of theaircraft was dark without emergency lightingwhile passengers were exiting the aircraft.
The forward Door Right 1 escape slide fell tothe ground un-inflated when the door was
opened. A number of ground personnel ran
to the front of the aircraft and helped 22
passengers off the forward Door Left 1 slide
and directed them towards the terminal. Fourpassengers exited by the Door 2 slide at the
rear of the aircraft and ran into the middle
of the apron. The over-wing exits were not
opened.
The aircrafts dispatcher had not received anyeducation in emergency communications
with flight crew nor aircraft evacuations at theterminal. The reported smoke and sparks wasa result of the right engine air turbine starterfailing during the engine start sequence.
story-koala-077.audioTextZh:
2005年5月17日，一架波音737-200型飞机计划执飞从霍巴特飞往悉尼的定期公共运输航班，于东部标准时间06:00起飞，机上有6名机组人员和26名乘客。

在启动右发动机时，飞机调度员告知机组人员，右发动机有烟雾和火花喷出，并建议让所有人撤离飞机。机长在未启动《乘客撤离检查单》程序的情况下，下令进行紧急撤离。结果，在乘客撤离飞机时，机翼襟翼没有设置到展开位置，飞机尾部一片漆黑，没有应急照明。

当右侧1号前舱门打开时，该舱门的逃生滑梯未充气就掉到了地面。一些地面工作人员跑到飞机前部，帮助22名乘客从左侧1号前舱门的滑梯撤离，并引导他们前往候机楼。4名乘客从飞机后部的2号舱门滑梯撤离，然后跑到了停机坪中间。机翼上方的应急出口并未打开。

飞机调度员没有接受过任何关于与机组人员进行紧急通信以及在机场候机楼进行飞机撤离相关的培训。所报告的烟雾和火花是由于右发动机空气涡轮起动机在发动机启动过程中发生故障导致的。

story-koala-078.audioText:
The DC-10 aircraft was flying from Kingstonto Toronto Airport. The aircraft departed
Kingston at 1400 Eastern Standard Time withthe first office designated as the pilot flying.During the initial climb following take-off,
the first officer noted that abnormal forwardpressure on the control column was requiredto keep the aircraft from pitching nose up. Tocounter the pitch-up, he trimmed the aircraftnose down. Thirty seconds after becoming
airborne, the aircraft was 350 feet above
ground level and the first officer had appliedfull nose-down trim. The amount of forwardpressure on the control column continued toincrease as the aircraft accelerated, and the
first officer notified the captain of the controldifficulties and requested his assistance in
holding the control column forward.
As the aircraft climbed, the captain declaredan emergency, indicating that they were
experiencing control difficulties and that theaircraft may have to land nearby. The flight
crew leveled the aircraft at 4000 feet on
the sea level and pulled the elevator pitch
disconnect handle, isolating the left and
right elevators. The captain's elevator controlfunctioned normally after the disconnection,and he decided to continue the flight. The
flight crew conducted a flapless landing at
Toronto without further incident.
When the aircraft was inspected after landing,the right-side elevator spring tab was jammedin the trailing-edge-down position.
story-koala-078.audioTextZh:
这架DC-10型飞机当时正从金斯敦飞往多伦多机场。飞机于东部标准时间14点从金斯敦起飞，由副驾驶担任操纵飞行员。

在起飞后的初始爬升阶段，副驾驶注意到需要在操纵杆上施加异常的向前推力，才能防止飞机机头上扬。为了抵消机头的上仰，他将飞机的配平调整为机头向下。飞机起飞30秒后，高度达到了离地面350英尺，此时副驾驶已经将配平调至最大的机头向下位置。随着飞机加速，需要在操纵杆上施加的向前推力继续增大，副驾驶告知机长飞机操纵出现困难，并请求机长帮忙向前按住操纵杆。

在飞机爬升过程中，机长宣布了紧急情况，表明他们遇到了操纵困难，飞机可能需要在附近降落。机组人员将飞机在海拔4000英尺高度保持平飞，并拉动了升降舵俯仰脱开手柄，使左右升降舵分离。脱开连接后，机长的升降舵控制功能恢复正常，于是他决定继续飞行。机组人员在没有放下襟翼的情况下在多伦多着陆，此后未再发生其他意外情况。

飞机着陆后进行检查时发现，右侧升降舵的弹簧调整片卡在了后缘向下的位置。

story-koala-079.audioText:
June 21， 2002 FAA reminds all pilots to
be particularly alert in their own flight
preparations as well as activities at their localairports. This week incident with the Cessna182, which is flying into restricted airspace inWashington, D.C. clearly indicates that flightpreparation is more important than ever. TheC-182 was intercepted by military aircraft
after inadvertently straying into the restrictedairspace while attempting to avoid bad
weather.
Before taking off, the pilots should contactFAA Flight Service to receive the latest
information; know and understand all
applicable NOTAMs, and know where the
Temporary Flight Restrictions are. Also
maintain high vigilance at local airports, reportsuspicious activities to local authorities, andtake the time to secure the airplane before you
leave. It is critical that pilots continue to usethe highest levels of preparation, responsibilityand judgment, and that they encourage others
to do so as well.
story-koala-079.audioTextZh:
2002年6月21日，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）提醒所有飞行员，在进行自身的飞行准备工作以及在当地机场的活动时要格外警惕。本周发生的塞斯纳182飞机事件清楚地表明，飞行准备工作比以往任何时候都更加重要。这架塞斯纳182飞机在试图避开恶劣天气时，因疏忽误入了华盛顿特区的限制空域，随后遭到了军用飞机的拦截。

起飞前，飞行员应联系美国联邦航空管理局的飞行服务部门以获取最新信息；了解并熟知所有适用的航行通告（NOTAM），并且清楚临时飞行限制区域的位置。同时，在当地机场也要保持高度警惕，向当地有关部门报告可疑活动，并在离开前花时间妥善保管好飞机。至关重要的是，飞行员应继续以最高标准做好准备工作，履行职责并做出正确判断，并且也应鼓励其他人这样做。

story-koala-080.audioText:
On May 25,2002， a Boeing 747-200 aircraftperformed the flight from Taiwan Chung
Cheng airport to Hongkong international
airport, carrying 206 passengers and 19 crewmembers on board. It broke up and crashed atan altitude of 34,900 feet 23 miles northeastof Magong City in Penghu County, killing all
those on board. It is the deadliest air disasterin Taiwan. After careful investigation, scientistsfound the full story of the crash.About 20
years ago, the plane landed heavily at Kai TakAirport in Hong Kong and damaged the skinon its tail. After the damage to the tail, ChinaAirlines only covered the area with a piece ofaluminum plate similar to the damaged skin
and painted it. Instead of replacing the wholeskin in accordance with the maintenance
guidelines issued by Boeing. This cause a
buildup of metal fatigue in the area. For 22
years, maintenance crews had not noticed
anythirng unusual. After the split, the aircraftexperienced decompression disintegration.
According to the fuselage recovered after theaccident, the crack is at least 90.5 inches long,and studies have shown that the structure
could collapse if the crack is more than 58
inches in the air.
story-koala-080.audioTextZh:
2002年5月25日，一架波音747-200型飞机执行从台湾中正机场飞往香港国际机场的航班任务，机上搭载着206名乘客和19名机组人员。这架飞机在澎湖县马公市东北方向23英里、高度34900英尺的空中解体坠毁，机上人员全部遇难。这是台湾地区最严重的空难事件。

经过仔细调查，科学家们查明了此次坠机事件的全貌。大约20年前，这架飞机在香港启德机场重重着陆，导致机尾蒙皮受损。机尾受损后，中华航空公司只是用一块与受损蒙皮相似的铝板覆盖了受损区域并进行了喷漆处理，而没有按照波音公司发布的维修指南更换整块蒙皮。这就导致该区域金属疲劳不断累积。22年来，维修人员一直没有发现任何异常情况。飞机出现裂缝后，发生了解压解体。

根据事故后回收的机身情况来看，裂缝至少有90.5英寸长，而且研究表明，在空中如果裂缝长度超过58英寸，飞机结构就可能会坍塌。

story-koala-081.audioText:
Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport, also known as
Jiuzhaigou Airport and Jiuhuang Airport, is anairport in Songpan County, Sichuan province.It is about 240km from Chengdu Shuangliu
International Airport, an important aviation
hub of Southwest China. It is one of the
highest airport in the world with an altitude of3448 meters. There are breathtaking mountainranges on both sides of the axis of the runway,and the highest Xuebao peak is the main peakof Minshan Mountain, more than 18000 feet
above the sea level. The terrain is complex andwind changes rapidly near the airport. So it isconsidered one of the most difficult airports
to fly to in China, aircraft must typically fly at afaster airspeed in order to takeoff or land, butthose who fly over here are also amazed by thebeautiful scenery. Due to the high elevation,
some passengers may experience symotomsof altitude sickness. This should be taken intoconsideration when planning to fly into or outof the airport.
story-koala-081.audioTextZh: 九寨黄龙机场，又称九寨沟机场、九黄机场，位于四川省松潘县。它距离中国西南地区重要的航空枢纽成都双流国际机场约240公里。该机场是世界上海拔最高的机场之一，海拔达3448米。跑道中轴线两侧是令人叹为观止的山脉，其中最高的雪宝顶是岷山的主峰，海拔超过18000英尺。机场附近地形复杂，风向变化迅速。因此，它被认为是中国飞行难度最大的机场之一，飞机在起降时通常必须以更快的空速飞行，但飞过这里的人也会对这里的美丽景色惊叹不已。由于海拔较高，一些乘客可能会出现高原反应症状。在计划进出该机场时，这一点应该加以考虑。

story-koala-082.audioText:
On December 7th 2016， a Pakistan
International Airlines ATR42, performing flightPakistan661 from Chitral to Islamabad reportedthe failure of the left hand engine.The crew
shut the engine down and continued towardsIslamabad descending, some time later, theydeclared Mayday and shortly afterwards radioand radar contact was lost. The aircraft was
unable to maintain heading and turned left
before impact with the ground. The airline
reported there were 42 passengers, 3 flight
crew, 2 cabin crew and a mechanics on boardof the aircraft, and all occupants of the aircraftperished in the crash. The investigation into thecrash showed that the aaccident was causedby technical factors and was not caused by
human error. The flight crew of Pakistan661
faced an very complex technical error, that hadnever occurred before. Due to maintenance
irregularities, a turbine blade fractured causingfurther damage, that made it impossible to
control the aircraft.
story-koala-082.audioTextZh:
2016年12月7日，一架巴基斯坦国际航空公司的ATR42飞机执行从奇特拉尔飞往伊斯兰堡的巴基斯坦661号航班任务时，报告左侧发动机故障。机组人员关闭了该发动机，继续朝着伊斯兰堡下降飞行。一段时间后，他们发出了遇险信号（Mayday），不久之后，无线电和雷达联系均中断。

这架飞机无法保持航向，在撞击地面之前向左转向。该航空公司报告称，机上有42名乘客、3名飞行机组人员、2名客舱机组人员以及1名机械师，机上所有人员都在此次坠机事故中遇难。

对此次坠机事故的调查显示，事故是由技术因素导致的，并非人为失误造成。巴基斯坦661号航班的机组人员面临着一个极其复杂的、此前从未出现过的技术故障。由于维护方面的不合规操作，一个涡轮叶片断裂，进而造成了进一步的损坏，使得飞机无法操控。

story-koala-083.audioText:
A MyCargo Airlines Boeing 747-400 freighteron behalf of Turkish Airlines, performing flightTK-6491 from Hong Kong to Bishkek with
4 crew, was on final approach to Bishkek's
runway 26 at 07：18 local time when the aircraftwent around from very low height but did notclimb out to safety altitude, impacted terrainabout 1100 meters past the runway end and
went through a couple of houses of a village.All 4 crew on board the 747 as well as 35
people on the ground perished, 8 people onthe ground received injuries and were taken tohospitals.The cause of the Boeing 747 aircraftaccident was the missing control of the crewover the aircraft position in relation to the
glideslope during the autolmatic approach.
The flight was conducted at night in the
weather conditions, which is suitable for ICAOCAT Il landing. And as a result, the go-aroundwas not taken in due time and the aircraft hada significant deviation from the established
approach chart, which led to the controlled
flight into terrain.
story-koala-083.audioTextZh:
一架代表土耳其航空公司的麦卡戈货运航空公司（MyCargo Airlines）的波音747-400型货机，执飞从香港飞往比什凯克的TK-6491航班，机上有4名机组人员。当地时间07：18，这架飞机在对比什凯克26号跑道进行最后进近时，在很低的高度进行了复飞，但未能爬升至安全高度，在飞过跑道末端约1100米处撞击到了地面，并穿过了一个村庄的几栋房屋。

这架波音747飞机上的4名机组人员以及地面上的35人不幸遇难，8名地面人员受伤并被送往医院。这起波音747飞机事故的原因是，在自动进近过程中，机组人员未能正确掌控飞机相对于下滑道的位置。

此次飞行是在夜间进行的，当时的天气条件适合国际民用航空组织（ICAO）二类着陆标准。结果，机组人员没有及时进行复飞，并且飞机严重偏离了既定的进近图表，最终导致了可控飞行撞地事故的发生。

story-koala-084.audioText:
On April 29th 2013， a National Air Cargo
Boeing 747-400 freighter on behalf of US
Mobility Command, performing cargo flight
from Bagram to Dubai with 7 crew and cargo
consisting of 5 military vehicles, has crashed
shortly after takeoff. All 7 crew are reported
perished in the crash. Afghan Authorities
immediately denied claims that the crash of
a large civilian cargo aircraft was the result
of enemy activities. Several observers on
theground reported the National Air Cargo
Boeing 747 had just lifted off and was climbingthrough approximately 1200 feet when it's
nose sharply rose, the aircraft appeared to
have stalled and came down. According to
a listener on frequency, the crew reported
the aircraft stalled due to a possible load
shift. The National Transportation Safety Boarddetermined that the probable cause of this
accident was National Airlines's inadequate
procedures fo restraining special cargo loads,
which resulted in the loadmaster's improper
restraint of the cargo. The cargo moved afterand damaged hydraulic systems Nos.1 and
2 and horizontal stabilizer drive mechanism
components, rendering the airplane
uncontrollable.
story-koala-084.audioTextZh:
2013年4月29日，一架代表美国机动司令部的美国国家航空货运公司（National Air Cargo）的波音747-400型货机，搭载着7名机组人员和包括5辆军用车辆在内的货物，执行从巴格拉姆飞往迪拜的货运航班任务，在起飞后不久坠毁。据报道，机上7名机组人员全部在此次坠机事故中遇难。

阿富汗当局立即否认了这架大型民用货机坠毁是敌方活动所致的说法。地面上的几名目击者称，这架美国国家航空货运公司的波音747飞机刚刚起飞，在爬升至大约1200英尺高度时，机头急剧上扬，飞机似乎失速并坠落。据监听相关频率的人员称，机组人员报告称飞机可能因货物移位而失速。

美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是美国国家航空公司在约束特殊货物装载方面的程序不完善，导致货物装卸主管对货物的固定不当。货物移动后损坏了1号和2号液压系统以及水平安定面驱动机构部件，致使飞机失去控制。

story-koala-085.audioText:
On June 10th 2018， an American Airlines
Boeing 777-200 performing flight AA60 fromTokyo to Dallas with 269 people on board, wason approach to Dallas descending through
about 9000 feet when the aircraft encounteredmoderate turbulence.
According to National Transportation Safety
Board, as the flight began its descent into
KDF, the captain illuminated the seat belt signand made a public address announcement
reminding passengers to buckle up for the
remainder of the flight. Then theairplane
entered a band of small cumulus clouds and
experienced 10-15 seconds of moderate
turbulence.
When the turbulence was encountered, the
flight attendants were conducting their final
cabin safety checks, so 7 flight attendants
received minor injuries, one passenger, who
ignored the seat-belt sign and instructions toremain seated, injured his left ankle.
The aircraft continued for a landing on
Dallas airport runway 18R without further
incident about 12 minutes later. The flight
crew requested parameedics to meet the
airplane at the gate. Finally, the passenger wastransported to the hospital, and the 7 flight
attendants were treated at the airplane and
released.
story-koala-085.audioTextZh:
2018年6月10日，一架美国航空公司的波音777-200型飞机执行从东京飞往达拉斯的AA60航班，机上载有269人。当飞机下降至约9000英尺高度，正在进近达拉斯时，遭遇了中度颠簸。

根据美国国家运输安全委员会的报告，当航班开始下降飞往达拉斯沃思堡国际机场（KDF）时，机长打开了安全带指示灯，并通过客舱广播提醒乘客在航班剩余时间内系好安全带。随后，飞机进入了一片小块积云区域，并经历了10到15秒的中度颠簸。

遭遇颠簸时，空乘人员正在进行最后的客舱安全检查，因此7名空乘人员受了轻伤。有一名乘客无视安全带指示灯以及要求其留在座位上的指示，结果左脚踝受伤。

大约12分钟后，这架飞机继续在达拉斯机场18R跑道降落，此后未再发生其他意外情况。机组人员要求医护人员在登机口迎接飞机。最后，那名受伤乘客被送往医院，7名受伤的空乘人员在飞机上接受了治疗后并无大碍。

story-koala-086.audioText:
On March 31st 2014,A Jetblue EmbraerERJ-190O performing flight B6-876 fromKingston to Fort Lauderdale with 98
passengers,encountered smoke in cockpitshortly after departure.
The aircraft was cleared to FL340 proceeding
northtowards the boundary with Havana and
was about to contact Havana Control when the
smell of smoke was detected by the cockpit
crew and after some discussion, the decision
was made to return to Kincgston. The crewdeclared an emergency to aïr traffic control,then the captain elected to hand over pilotflying duties to the first officer in order togive his atention to the overall management
of the situatior. Both pilots put on their
Oxygen masks, and begun the descent andpreparations to return to Kingston alnd they
made the decision to evacuate the aircraft on
therunway.
Finally the aircraft landed safely about 15minutes after takeoff. 6injured passengersreceived medical assistance after landing.
story-koala-086.audioTextZh:
2014年3月31日，一架捷蓝航空的巴西航空工业公司ERJ-190型飞机执飞从金斯敦飞往劳德代尔堡的B6-876航班，机上载有98名乘客，在起飞后不久驾驶舱内出现烟雾。

这架飞机获批爬升至340飞行高度层（FL340），向北朝着与哈瓦那的边界飞行。就在即将联系哈瓦那空管时，驾驶舱机组人员察觉到了烟雾气味。经过一番讨论后，机组决定返回金斯敦。机组人员向空中交通管制部门宣布了紧急情况，随后机长选择将操纵飞机的职责移交给副驾驶，以便自己能专注于整体情况的处理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降并为返回金斯敦做准备，他们还决定在跑道上疏散乘客。

最终，这架飞机在起飞约15分钟后安全着陆。6名受伤的乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

story-koala-087.audioText:
On August 11th 2016， a Jetblue Airbus A320-200, performing flight B6-429 from Boston, toSacramento with 146 passengers and 5 crew,was climbing from FL320 presumably to FL340
when the crew stopped the climb at FL334about 90nm southeast of Rlapid City, due toturbulence causing injuries to 24 passengersand 3 cabin crew. The aircraft diverted t RapidCity for a safe landing on runway 32 about 25minutes after stopping the climb at FL334. The
27 injured were taken to a hospital with minorinjuries. Passengers reported those not beltedinto their seats were lifted against the ceilingand then slammed down again. A number
of cabin ceiling panels received cracks. A
replacement A320 was dispatched to RapidCityand reached Sacramento with a delay of 7.5
hours. According to National TransportationSafety Board, probable cause of the occurrence
was an inadvertent encounter with convectiveturbulence while in cruise flight.
story-koala-087.audioTextZh:
2016年8月11日，一架捷蓝航空的空客A320-200型飞机执行从波士顿飞往萨克拉门托的B6-429航班，机上载有146名乘客和5名机组人员。当飞机从320飞行高度层（FL320）爬升，预计要升至340飞行高度层时，机组在拉皮德城东南约90海里处的334飞行高度层（FL334）停止了爬升，原因是气流颠簸导致24名乘客和3名客舱机组人员受伤。

在FL334高度层停止爬升约25分钟后，这架飞机备降拉皮德城，在32号跑道安全着陆。27名伤者被送往医院，均为轻伤。乘客们称，没有系好安全带的人被抛向天花板，然后又重重地摔下来。客舱的一些天花板镶板出现了裂缝。

一架替补的A320飞机被派往拉皮德城，最终晚点7.5小时抵达萨克拉门托。根据美国国家运输安全委员会的说法，这起事件的可能原因是飞机在巡航飞行时意外遭遇了对流性颠簸。

story-koala-088.audioText:
A Sun Express Germany Boeing 737-800，
performirng flight XG-3208 from Burgas to
Frankfurt, was cleared to climb to and maintainFL220. At the same time, a Go2Sky Boeing
737-800 performing flight 6D-6129 from
Antalya to Bratislava was enroute at FL240
did not want to change their flight level. ATCinstructed XG-3208 to turn left onto a heading270. The crew however, read back "Climb
FL270", which was not picked up by ATC.
The crew selected FL270 into their Selected
Altitude, and this was duely transmitted by
Mode-S to the controller's desk, where a
disagree message appeared between clearedand assigned altitude. The aircraft began to
climb, about 15 seconds later, the radar issueda short term conflict alert between XG-3208
and 6D-6129.Then ATC instructed XG-3208 todescend back to FL220 immediately,4 secondslater the crew read that instruction back. Andthe aircraft already climbed through FL236.
The separation reduced to 0 feet vertically and2.6nm horizontally and the aircraft continuedto climb reaching FL250, and re-establishing
vertical separation. ATC thus instructed
XG-3208 to continue the climb to FL260.
story-koala-088.audioTextZh:
. 一架德国阳光快运航空公司（Sun Express Germany）的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从布尔加斯飞往法兰克福的XG-3208航班，获得许可爬升至并保持在220飞行高度层（FL220）。与此同时，一架Go2Sky航空公司的波音737-800型飞机执飞从安塔利亚飞往布拉迪斯拉发的6D-6129航班，正在240飞行高度层（FL240）航路上飞行，且不想改变其飞行高度层。空中交通管制（ATC）指令XG-3208航班左转至航向270度。然而，机组复诵的是“爬升至270飞行高度层（FL270）”，而空中交通管制并未注意到这一错误复诵。

机组人员在其选定高度设置中选择了FL270，并且通过S模式适时地将这一信息传输到了管制员的操作台上，此时在许可高度和设定高度之间出现了不一致的提示信息。飞机开始爬升，大约15秒后，雷达发出了XG-3208航班和6D-6129航班之间的短期冲突警报。随后，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班立即下降至FL220，4秒后机组复诵了该指令。而此时飞机已经爬升至236飞行高度层。

两机的垂直间隔缩小至0英尺，水平间隔为2.6海里，并且这架飞机继续爬升，达到了250飞行高度层，随后重新建立了垂直间隔。因此，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班继续爬升至260飞行高度层。

story-koala-089.audioText:
On January 29th 2015， a Ryanair Boeing
737-800,performing FR-8592 from London
to Bergerac, was on NDB approach Y
to Bergerac's runway 28 in instrument
meteorological conditions. The aircraft
descended below minimum safe altitude whenit was handed off to tower. The approach
controller received a Minimum Safe Altitude
Warning and thee aircraft's EGPWS issued a
warning, too. The crew initiated a go-around
and the aircraft climbed to safe altitude. Thenthe crew positioned for another approach andlanded safely on runway 28 about 24 minutesafter aborting the first aproach. According
to the investigation, the incident occurred
while the aircraft performed an NDB approachwithout DME,probably without external visualreferences. Meanwhile, the first preparation
of the approach was probably incomplete or
imprecise. As a result, the late modification didnot permit the crew to agree on the guidancemodes. This resulted in confusion of the
captain as to the horizontal trajectory to be
followed by the aircraft. This state of confusionled him to request an early descent below thesafety altitude.
story-koala-089.audioTextZh:
2015年1月29日，一架瑞安航空的波音737-800型飞机执行从伦敦飞往贝杰拉克的FR-8592航班，在仪表气象条件下，采用无方向信标（NDB）进近方式，朝着贝杰拉克机场28号跑道进近。

当飞机移交给塔台管制时，它下降到了最低安全高度以下。进近管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的增强型近地警告系统（EGPWS）也发出了警告。机组人员启动了复飞程序，飞机爬升至安全高度。然后机组人员重新调整位置准备再次进近，并在放弃第一次进近约24分钟后，安全降落在28号跑道上。

根据调查，这起事件发生在飞机在没有测距仪（DME）且可能没有外部目视参考的情况下进行无方向信标进近时。同时，第一次进近的准备工作可能不完整或不准确。因此，后期的修正没能让机组人员就引导模式达成一致。这导致机长对于飞机应遵循的水平航线感到困惑。这种困惑的状态使他要求飞机提前下降到安全高度以下。

story-koala-090.audioText:
On October 25th 2018， a Vueling Airbus
A320-200, performing flight VY-1431 from
Bilbao to Barcelona with 114 passengers and
6 crew, departed Bilbao's runway. At that
time, the left engine dropped two bonnets.
In the absence of any abnormal indicationss
and unaware of the separation, the crew
continued the flight to Barcelona for a safe
landing. Although a part of the engine cowlingbecame stuck in the left main gear, the gear
retracted normally after takeoff and extendedin Barcelona without prololems. The aircraft
received minor damage at the left main gear
and the left side of the fuselage where debrishit, however all persons on board disembarkednormally, no medical attention was needed.Theinvestigation has determined that the incidentwas caused by flying the airplane without
closing and properly latching the cowls on theairplane's left engine, which was in turn causedby an improper maintenance operation, and bythe incorrect performance of the walk-aroundcheck prior to the flight.
story-koala-090.audioTextZh:
2018年10月25日，一架伏林航空（Vueling）的空客A320-200型飞机执行从毕尔巴鄂飞往巴塞罗那的VY-1431航班，机上载有114名乘客和6名机组人员，从毕尔巴鄂机场跑道起飞。就在那时，左发动机的两个发动机罩脱落了。

由于没有任何异常指示，机组人员也未察觉到部件脱落，便继续飞往巴塞罗那并安全着陆。尽管有一部分发动机整流罩卡在了左主起落架上，但起落架在起飞后正常收起，在巴塞罗那着陆前也正常放下，没有出现问题。飞机的左主起落架以及机身左侧被碎片击中的部位受到了轻微损伤，不过机上所有人员都正常下机，无人需要医疗救治。

调查认定，这起事件的原因是飞机在左发动机整流罩未关闭且未正确锁好的情况下起飞，而这又是由不当的维修操作以及飞行前绕机检查执行不到位所导致的。

story-koala-091.audioText:
On April 28th 2018， a Qantas Boeing
737-800, perfornning flight QF567 from
Sydney to Perth, had safely landed on Perth'srunway 03， vacated the runway via taxiway
J2 but taxied past the hold short point of
runway 06 and crossed an illuminated stop
bar without an air traffic control clearance.
Another Qantas Boeing 737-800， performingfligInt QF582 from Perth to Sydney, was
accelerating for takeoff from runway 06 whenQF567 crossed the hold short line on taxiwayJ2, prompting tower to instruct QF582 to stopimmediately. QF582 rejecteed takeoff and
came to a stop near taxiway J2. The aircraftvacated the runway via taxiway A and returnedto the apron. The Australia Transport SafetyBureau report into the serious incident has
blamed taxiway design, flight crew distractionand incorrect mental model for the runway
incursion of another flight QF567. The ATSBsaid that soon after, the flight crew of QF567became aware of their position and stoppedtheir aircraft just before crossing the edge ofrunway 06 with QF582's wingtip passing about
15 meters from QF567's nose at low speed just
before coming to a stop.
story-koala-091.audioTextZh:
2018年4月28日，一架澳航（Qantas）的波音737-800型飞机执行从悉尼飞往珀斯的QF567航班，已安全降落在珀斯机场的03号跑道上，随后通过J2滑行道脱离跑道，但滑行时越过了06号跑道的等待点，并且在未经空中交通管制许可的情况下穿过了亮起的停止标志杆。

另一架澳航的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从珀斯飞往悉尼的QF582航班，正在06号跑道上加速准备起飞，就在这时QF567航班越过了J2滑行道上的等待线，这促使塔台立即指示QF582航班停止。QF582航班中止了起飞，在J2滑行道附近停了下来。这架飞机随后通过A滑行道脱离跑道，返回停机坪。

澳大利亚运输安全局（Australia Transport Safety Bureau）对这起严重事件的报告指出，QF567航班发生跑道侵入事件的原因在于滑行道设计问题、机组人员注意力分散以及对跑道情况的错误心理认知模式。澳大利亚运输安全局表示，不久后，QF567航班的机组人员意识到了他们的位置，在即将越过06号跑道边缘前停下了飞机，而QF582航班的翼尖在即将停下前以低速从距离QF567航班机头约15米处掠过。

story-koala-092.audioText:
On Nov 20th 2013， an Atlas Air Boeing
747-400 Drealmlifter, performing freight flight5Y4241 from New York to Wichita McConnell
Airbase, with 2 crew, was on a GPS/RNAV
approach to McConnel Airport's runway 19L,
but unintentionally landed on runway 18 of
Wichita's Jabara Airport, and managed to
stop the aircraft on the runway. The crew
subsequently reported to be on the ground
and intending to vacate via taxiway D, to whichthe puzzled tower responded "stand by",
then reporting they were about 8nm from theaerodrome. The crew believed they had landedon Wichita's Beech Airport, the even more
puzzled tower controller replied "confirm you
landed at Beech Airport?", the crew requestedthe UNICOM frequency for Beech after the
tower had reported the tower was closed at
that time of the night. McConnell Tower thenreported the coordinates of Beech Airport,
the crew returned the coordinates, after whichtower identified the airport as Jabara accordingto those position data. In the meantime a
person on the ground had arrived at the
aircraft and told the crew the local frequency.
The aircraft and airport sustained no damage.
story-koala-092.audioTextZh:
2013年11月20日，一架阿特拉斯航空（Atlas Air）的波音747-400“梦想运输者”（Dreamlifter）货机，执行从纽约飞往威奇托麦康奈尔空军基地的5Y4241货运航班，机上有两名机组人员。该飞机当时正采用全球定位系统/区域导航（GPS/RNAV）进近方式，准备降落至麦康奈尔机场的19L跑道，但却意外降落在了威奇托贾巴拉机场的18跑道上，并且成功在跑道上使飞机停了下来。

随后，机组人员报告称已在地面，并打算通过D滑行道脱离跑道，对此感到困惑的塔台回应称“请稍等”，然后机组报告称他们距离机场大约8海里。机组人员认为他们降落在了威奇托的比奇机场，更加困惑的塔台管制员回应道“确认你们降落在了比奇机场？”。在塔台告知当晚那个时候比奇机场的塔台已经关闭后，机组人员索要了比奇机场的通用航空无线电台（UNICOM）频率。接着，麦康奈尔机场塔台报告了比奇机场的坐标，机组人员回复了坐标，之后塔台根据那些位置数据确定该机场是贾巴拉机场。与此同时，地面上有一个人来到了飞机旁，并告知了机组人员当地的频率。飞机和机场均未受到损坏。

story-koala-093.audioText:
A bmi Regional Embraer ERJ-145, performingflight BM1753 from Munich to Norrkoping with18 passegers and 3 crew, was self-positioningfor an ILS approach to Norrkoping's runway
27. The aircraft was cleared to descend to
2100 feet and cleared the approach to runway27. At the same time an ultralight aircraft
was operating below the controlled airspacein uncontrolled airspace performing a VFR
flight, the two aircraft were on different radiofrequencies. While still positioning to interceptthe localizer, the aircraft automatically turnedwest and began to descend, one pilot believedthey were capturing the glideslope, the otherpilot believed they were on localizer and aboveglide. The crew changed from automatic
glideslope coupling to vertical speed and
increased the rate of descent to re-capture theglideslope. The crew subsequently queried
about the target on their TCAS screen and thealtitude of the Embraer. When the distance
reduced to 1 nautical mile horizontally and
200 feet vertically, the Embraer's TCAS issueda resolution advisory, and the crew initiated ago around. The aircraft positioned for anotherapproach and landed safely about 10 minuteslater.
story-koala-093.audioTextZh:
一架英国米德兰地区航空公司（bmi Regional）的巴西航空工业公司ERJ-145型飞机，执飞从慕尼黑飞往北雪平的BM1753航班，机上载有18名乘客和3名机组人员，当时正在自行调整位置，准备采用仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近北雪平机场的27号跑道。

这架飞机获得许可下降至2100英尺，并获批进近27号跑道。与此同时，一架超轻型飞机在管制空域下方的非管制空域内进行目视飞行规则（VFR）飞行，两架飞机使用的是不同的无线电频率。

在仍处于调整位置以截获航向道的时候，这架飞机自动向西转弯并开始下降。一名飞行员认为他们正在截获下滑道，而另一名飞行员则认为他们处于航向道上且在下滑道上方。机组人员将自动下滑道耦合模式改为垂直速度模式，并增加了下降率以重新截获下滑道。

随后，机组人员对他们的空中交通防撞系统（TCAS）屏幕上的目标以及这架ERJ-145飞机的高度提出了疑问。当两机的水平距离缩小至1海里、垂直距离缩小至200英尺时，这架ERJ-145飞机的防撞系统发出了避让建议，机组人员启动了复飞程序。

这架飞机重新调整位置进行再次进近，并在大约10分钟后安全着陆。

story-koala-094.audioText:
On September 30th 2018， an Easyjet AirusA319 performing flight U2-211 from Londonto Glasgow, with 148 passengers and 6 crewwas descending towards Glasgow when thefirst officer, pilot flying, became unfit to fly,relinquished control to the captain and left the
cockpit. The commander declared PAN andcontinued for a safe landing in Glasgow.Theprobable cause of the incident was that theco-pilot experienced anxiety which developed
into an anxiety attack during the approach to
Glasgow. Thee commander, ATC and cabincrew worked together effectively to achievea safe single pilot landing and to get medicalhelp for the co-pilot. The opportunity for the
incident to occur might have been reducedby the co-pilot reporting unfit for duty, more
effective communication between the co-pilot
and the commaander, and use of supportavailable from peers or one of the official
assistance programmes.
story-koala-094.audioTextZh:
2018年9月30日，一架易捷航空（Easyjet）的空客A319型飞机执行从伦敦飞往格拉斯哥的U2-211航班，机上载有148名乘客和6名机组人员。在飞机朝着格拉斯哥下降的过程中，担任操纵飞行员的副驾驶身体状况不适宜继续飞行，便将飞机控制权移交给机长，随后离开了驾驶舱。

机长宣布了“PAN”（表示遇到紧急情况但尚未达到最危急程度的信号），并继续安全降落在格拉斯哥。这起事件的可能原因是，副驾驶在进近格拉斯哥的过程中产生了焦虑情绪，进而发展成了焦虑发作。

机长、空中交通管制人员以及客舱机组人员进行了有效协作，成功实现了单飞行员安全着陆，并为副驾驶提供了医疗救助。如果副驾驶能更早报告自己不适宜执行任务，副驾驶与机长之间能进行更有效的沟通，或者副驾驶能利用同事提供的支持，或者借助官方援助项目之一，那么这起事件发生的可能性或许会降低。

story-koala-095.audioText:
An AirAsia Airbus 330-300， with 359 peopleon board, was enroute at FL380 about 200
nautical mile southwest of Perth. Then the
left hand engine suffered a blade fracture.
the engine ingested the blade and caused
severe damage in engine core and severe
vibrations. The crew shut the engine down,
and drifted the aircraft down to FL200, and
returned to Peerth for a safe landing about
2 hours after the engine failure. Passengers
reported they heard a large bang, follovved bysevere vibrations, and sounds like a spinningwashing machine. They were instructed to
brace for landing. Australia's emergency
services reported, they puttheir marine
emergency services on standby for a possiblewater landing. The airline reported the aircraftreturned to Perth due to a technical problem,but they didn't confirm it is an engine issue.
Emergency services were called as precautiononly as part of the standard operating
procedures. The passengers then rebooked
onto other flights.
story-koala-095.audioTextZh:
一架载有359人的亚洲航空（AirAsia）空客A330-300型飞机，当时正在珀斯西南约200海里处、380飞行高度层（FL380）的航路上飞行。随后，其左侧发动机的一个叶片发生断裂。发动机吸入了该叶片，导致发动机核心部分受到严重损坏，并引发了剧烈振动。
机组人员关闭了这台发动机，让飞机下降至200飞行高度层（FL200），并在发动机失效约2小时后返回珀斯安全着陆。乘客们称，他们听到了一声巨响，紧接着是剧烈的振动，还听到了类似旋转的洗衣机发出的声音。他们接到指令，要做好着陆的防冲击姿势。
澳大利亚的应急服务部门报告称，他们让海上应急服务处于待命状态，以防飞机可能会在水上迫降。该航空公司表示，飞机因技术问题返回珀斯，但并未确认这是发动机问题。呼叫应急服务部门只是作为预防措施，是标准操作程序的一部分。之后，乘客们重新预订了其他航班。

story-koala-096.audioText:
An Eastar Jet B737-800, performing flight
from Korea to Japan, was cleared for the
approach to runway 03L. However, the aircraftwas aligned with runway 03R. But the runway03R was occupied by a vehicle. The aircraft
went around from very low height. Ther it
positioned for another approach to runway
z03L. Finally, the aircraft landed safely on
runway O3L about 9 minutes after the go
around.JTSB reported, that they have openedan investigation into the incident. The east siderunway was occupied by a vehicle when the
aircraft attempteed to land on. But the aircraftdidn't land on the right runway as instructed
by ATC. The aircraft went around and landed
at the west side runway 9 minutes later.
JTSB released their final report, explaining
tlhe probable causes of the serious incident.
In this serious incident, it is highly probable
that because the Captain of the Aircraft
misidentified and the runway. he made an
approach for the different rlunway where an
inspection vehicle was running on.
story-koala-096.audioTextZh:
一架东星航空（Eastar Jet）的波音737-800型飞机，执行从韩国飞往日本的航班任务，获得许可进近03L跑道。然而，这架飞机却对准了03R跑道。但03R跑道上有一辆车辆占用。飞机在很低的高度进行了复飞。随后，它重新调整位置，准备再次进近03L跑道。最终，在复飞约9分钟后，这架飞机安全降落在了03L跑道上。

日本运输安全委员会（JTSB）报告称，他们已对这起事件展开调查。当飞机试图降落时，东侧跑道（03R跑道）被一辆车辆占用。但飞机没有按照空中交通管制（ATC）的指示降落在正确的跑道上。飞机进行了复飞，并在9分钟后降落在了西侧跑道（03L跑道）上。

日本运输安全委员会发布了最终报告，解释了这起严重事件的可能原因。在这起严重事件中，极有可能是因为飞机机长认错了跑道，所以他对准了有一辆检查车辆正在行驶的另一条跑道进行进近。

story-koala-097.audioText:
An Air France Airbus A319-100, performs
flight frorn London to Paris with 136 people
on board. When the aircraft was climbing
through FL230, the crew donned their oxygenmasks, declared Mayday and requested an
immediate return to London. The crelw
advised they suspected a fire on board, and
then, they reported they had smoke and fumesin the caockpit. The aircraft landed safely
back on runway 13R about 23 minutes after
departure. The crew advised they were able
to vacate the runway as the flight attendantsconfirmed there was no fire on board. Finally,
the aircraft taxied to the apron. The aircraft wasable to depart about 4 hours after landing,
and reached Paris with a delay of 4.5 hours.
Maintenance identified a faulty display as
source of the fumes and smoke. The incidentwas evoked by internal failure of the top
middle display unit of the cockpit dashboard.
story-koala-097.audioTextZh:
一架法国航空公司（Air France）的空客A319-100型飞机，执行从伦敦飞往巴黎的航班，机上载有136人。当飞机爬升至230飞行高度层（FL230）时，机组人员戴上了氧气面罩，发出了遇险信号（Mayday），并请求立即返回伦敦。机组人员表示，他们怀疑飞机上有火灾，随后，他们报告称驾驶舱内有烟雾。

这架飞机在起飞约23分钟后安全返回，降落在13R跑道上。机组人员表示，由于空乘人员确认机上没有火灾，他们得以驶离跑道。最后，飞机滑行至停机坪。这架飞机在降落后约4小时得以再次起飞，晚点4.5小时抵达巴黎。

维修人员确定，有故障的显示屏是烟雾的来源。这起事件是由驾驶舱仪表盘顶部中间显示单元的内部故障引发的。

story-koala-098.audioText:
A Scoot Airbus A319-100, performing flightPhilippines to Singapore with 129 people onboard, was descending towards Singapore
when the flight crew donned their oxygen
masks. Declared PAN PAN, reporting excessivecabin altitude and initiated an emergency
descent to 9000 feet. The aircraft continuedto Singapore for a safe landing on runway
20C about 23 minutes after declaring PAN
PAN. The likely cause of the excessive cabin
altitude was a corruption of LFE that is
landing field elevation in the CPC. The CPC
manufacturer believed that the corruption
arose from a fatigue solder joint on the CPCcircuit board. There had been past occurrencesof excessive caabin altitude that were causedby a corruption of LFE value in the CPC, of
which one was determined to have likely beencaused by a fatigue solder joint, similar to thisoccurrence.
story-koala-098.audioTextZh:
一架酷航（Scoot）的空客A319-100型飞机，搭载着129名乘客，执行从菲律宾飞往新加坡的航班任务。在飞机朝着新加坡下降的过程中，机组人员戴上了氧气面罩，发出了“PAN PAN”（表示紧急情况但情况尚不太危急的信号），报告客舱高度过高，并启动了紧急下降程序，降至9000英尺高度。

在发出“PAN PAN”信号约23分钟后，这架飞机继续飞往新加坡，并安全降落在20C跑道上。客舱高度过高的可能原因是客舱压力控制器（CPC）中的着陆场海拔（LFE）数据出现错误。客舱压力控制器的制造商认为，该数据错误是由客舱压力控制器电路板上的一个焊点疲劳导致的。

过去也曾发生过客舱高度过高的情况，原因也是客舱压力控制器中的着陆场海拔数值错误，其中有一次经判定很可能是由焊点疲劳引起的，与此次事件的情况类似。

story-koala-099.audioText:
On 26 June 2006， a British Airways Airbus
A320-20O pushed back using a towbarless
tractor at London Heathrow Airport. But
that unit was disconnected from the aircraft.
After receiving taxi clearance from ATC, the
aircraft started moving under its own power,
and shortly afterwards, collided with the
tractor that had just performed the pushback.Both the right engine of the aircraft and the
tractor were damaged. The investigation
report published in May 2017 stated, that theprimary causal factor of the accident, was theheadset operator giving the "all clear" signal
to the flight crew, before the tractor had
been repositioned to a safe distance from theaircraft. Contributory factors were the co-pilotfailing to see the tractor. What's more, the
fact that the tractor didn't drive away after theaircraft began to taxi was also a reason for thisaccident.
story-koala-099.audioTextZh:
2006年6月26日，一架英国航空公司的空客A320-200型飞机在伦敦希思罗机场使用无拖把牵引车进行后推操作。但牵引车与飞机脱开了连接。

在得到空中交通管制（ATC）的滑行许可后，飞机开始依靠自身动力移动，不久之后，就与刚刚完成后推操作的牵引车相撞。飞机的右发动机和牵引车均遭到损坏。

2017年5月发布的调查报告称，这起事故的主要原因是，在牵引车还未重新移动到离飞机安全距离之外时，头戴式耳机操作员就向机组人员发出了“一切正常”的信号。

促成事故发生的因素包括副驾驶没有看到牵引车。此外，在飞机开始滑行后，牵引车没有驶离这一情况也是导致这起事故的一个原因。

story-koala-100.audioText:
On August 1st 2018, an Aeromexico ConnectERJ'190 from Durango to Mexico rejected
takeoff from Durango's runway 03 because
of adverse weathel at about 15：15 local time.
The aircraft veered left off the runway, overranthe end of the runway and burst into flames
in viewing distance of the airport's apron. Theaircraft was destroyed, there were no fatalities,2 people received serious injuries and 83
people received minor injuries. Some peoplewith injuries were taken to a local hospital.
The airline stated there were 99 passengers
including 2 infants and 4 crew on board. Theaircraft was 10 years old and had operated forAeromexico since 2014. The local governor
reported the aircraft was about to take off
when the aircraft suffered an accicdent.
According to flight data recorder as well as
cockpit voice recorder, the pilots did a good
job to bring the plane down, which preventedthings from worse to catastrophe.
story-koala-100.audioTextZh:
2018年8月1日，当地时间约15点15分，一架墨西哥航空连接公司（Aeromexico Connect）的ERJ190型飞机执行从杜兰戈飞往墨西哥城的航班任务，由于恶劣天气，在杜兰戈机场03跑道上中断起飞。

飞机向左偏离跑道，冲出跑道末端，并在机场停机坪可视范围内起火燃烧。这架飞机损毁严重，所幸无人员死亡，2人受重伤，83人受轻伤。一些受伤人员被送往当地医院。

该航空公司称，机上有99名乘客（包括2名婴儿）和4名机组人员。这架飞机已服役10年，自2014年起为墨西哥航空公司执飞任务。当地州长报告称，飞机在即将起飞时发生了事故。

根据飞行数据记录器以及驾驶舱语音记录器显示，飞行员们采取了有效措施使飞机停下，避免了事态恶化成一场灾难。

story-koala-101.audioText:
A Delta Airlines Airbus 330， performing a
flight from New York to Paris， was enroute atFL380 about 700nm southwest of Reykjavik airport， Iceland when the crewdecided to divert to Iceland， reporting with
left hand engine failure. The crew requestedto descend to FL320 and set course for
Reykjavik. The diversion was approved by
Oceanic Control within a minute， however， therequest to descent took more than 15 minutesdue to a lot of traffic around that needed
to be moved out. The aircraft continued to
maintain FL380 in the meantime. Finally， theaircraft descended to FL290 and landed safelyon Iceland about 2 hours after the decision todivert. After the landing， another aircraft wassent from Amsterdam to fly the 96 passengersand cargo from lceland to Paris. According
to the investigation， the crew attempte to
move the thrust lever back and forth when
the engine started to vibrate， but this resultedin the ergine stalling a number of times. Thecrew thus declared emergency and diverted toIceland on single engine.
story-koala-101.audioTextZh:
一架达美航空公司（Delta Airlines）的空客330型飞机，执行从纽约飞往巴黎的航班任务。当飞机在冰岛雷克雅未克机场西南约700海里处、处于380飞行高度层（FL380）的航路上时，机组人员决定备降冰岛，报告称左侧发动机出现故障。

机组人员请求下降到320飞行高度层（FL320），并设定飞往雷克雅未克的航线。大洋管制部门在一分钟内就批准了此次备降，然而，由于周围空域有大量航班，需要先进行调配，所以下降请求过了15分钟才获批。在此期间，飞机继续保持在380飞行高度层。

最终，这架飞机下降到290飞行高度层（FL290），并在决定备降约2小时后安全降落在冰岛。飞机降落后，另一架从阿姆斯特丹派出的飞机将机上的96名乘客和货物从冰岛运往巴黎。

根据调查，当发动机开始出现振动时，机组人员试图来回移动推力杆，但这导致发动机多次失速。于是，机组人员宣布了紧急情况，并以单发动机状态备降冰岛。

story-koala-102.audioText:
A visual approach is an ATC authorization foraircrafit on IFR flight plan to proceed visually
to the airport, even to the landing. It is not aninstrument approach procedure, and there is
no missed approach segment. Even when an
aircraft is being vectored for an instrument
approach, controllers may initiate or pilots
may request a visual approach provided the
pilot subsequently reports the airport or
runway in sight. Before clearing an aircraft for
a visual approach, controllers should ensure
that weather conditions at the airport are VFR,and they need resolve potential conflicts with
all other aircraft. The pilot must, at all times,
have either the airportor the preceding aircraftin sight. This approach must be authorized
and under the control of the appropriate air
traffic control facility. Reported weather at theairport must be ceiling ator above 1000ft, andvisibility of 3 miles or greater. An aircraft unableto complete visual approach shall be handled
as any"go around", and appropriate separationmust be provided.
story-koala-102.audioTextZh:
目视进近是空中交通管制（ATC）对处于仪表飞行规则（IFR）飞行计划中的飞机的一种许可，允许其以目视方式飞往机场，甚至直接着陆。它并非一种仪表进近程序，且不存在复飞航段。

即使一架飞机正按引导进行仪表进近，只要飞行员随后报告已看到机场或跑道，管制员也可以发起、或者飞行员可以请求进行目视进近。在批准一架飞机进行目视进近之前，管制员应确保机场的天气状况符合目视飞行规则（VFR），并且他们需要解决与所有其他飞机之间可能存在的冲突。

飞行员在任何时候都必须能够看到机场或前方的飞机。这种进近方式必须得到相应空中交通管制机构的批准并处于其管控之下。机场所报告的天气状况必须是：云底高度达到或高于1000英尺，能见度为3英里或更远。

一架无法完成目视进近的飞机应按照任何“复飞”情况来处理，并且必须为其提供适当的间隔。

story-kongguan-001.audioText: One day in 2000, Flight 154 reported bird strike three minutes after takeoff, and requested return to the airport. But the controller told the crew that the RVR of the airport was below landing minima, so the captain made a decision to make an emergency landing at airport A. Air traffic controller quickly contacted A airport and gained permission for a landing on runway 15. However, the aircraft could not reach A airport due to lack of altitude. The crew decided to make a ditching in a river and they reported it to the controller. Finally, the crew made a ditching without power at about 150 miles per hour in the river.
story-kongguan-001.audioTextZh: 2000年的一天，154号航班起飞三分钟后报告遭遇鸟击，并请求返场。但管制员告知机组，该机场的跑道视程（RVR）低于着陆最低标准，因此机长决定在A机场紧急着陆。空中交通管制员迅速联系A机场，并获得在15号跑道着陆的许可。然而，由于高度不足，飞机无法到达A机场。机组决定在一条河流上实施水上迫降，并将这一决定报告给管制员。最终，机组以大约每小时150英里的速度，在无动力状态下迫降于河面。
story-kongguan-001.referenceText:
Q: what did flight 154 encounter after takeoff?
Did they return to land? Why?
Did they land at airport A?
What is the crew’s final decision?

story-kongguan-002.audioText: When SIA188 was approaching the airspace of Chicago Area Control Center, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn’t know that flight 188 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA188 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA188 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
story-kongguan-002.audioTextZh: 当SIA188接近芝加哥区域管制中心空域时，管制员指示机组将无线电频率改为下一扇区的132.1。副驾驶确认了频率转换指令，并正确复诵了该频率。然而，机组没有在新频率上联系空中交通管制。由于接收单位的管制员正在准备交接班，他们没有发现188号航班尚未建立无线电联系。30分钟后，下一扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出SIA188。尽管管制员尝试通过联系航空公司签派员与飞机建立联系，但始终没有收到飞行员的回应。50分钟后，管制员最终在应急频率上重新与SIA188取得联系。
story-kongguan-002.referenceText: Q: what abnormal thing happened to SIA188? Why didn’t controller know that flight 188 did not establish radio contact with next ATC? How did the controller establish contact with SIA188 50 minutes later?

story-kongguan-003.audioText: Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers. One day, a B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing. It was then cleared to cross runway 36R. But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R. The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply. He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off. This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R. So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R. Suddenly, the controller noticed the B757’s lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion, he cancelled A320’s takeoff clearance immediately.
story-kongguan-003.audioTextZh: 着陆灯信号可以为管制员提供有用信息。一天，一架B757着陆后经A9滑行道脱离36L跑道，随后获准穿越36R跑道。但飞机停在了36L与36R跑道之间的A9滑行道上。塔台管制员尝试联系飞行员，但没有收到回答。他还看到飞机的着陆灯处于关闭状态。这使他认为B757发生了无线电失效，并未收到穿越36R跑道的许可。因此，他向36R跑道上的一架A320发布了起飞许可。突然，管制员注意到B757的灯亮了起来，飞机也开始移动。意识到存在跑道侵入风险后，他立即取消了A320的起飞许可。
story-kongguan-003.referenceText: Q:Where did B757 stopped after vacating runway? What is the controller’s instruction to B757? Why did controller cancel takeoff clearance to A320?

story-kongguan-004.audioText: It was a foggy day in 2002, SIA 686 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R. A few minutes later, the Cessna pilot requested engine start. The ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then he requested Flight 686 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made a mistake to taxi to right and entered taxiway R6. But the ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the same time, the Tower controller cleared Flight 686 for takeoff. When the flight 686 was rolling on the runway, the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 114 people on board died.
story-kongguan-004.audioTextZh: 2002年一个有雾的日子，SIA686获准滑行前往36R跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳的飞行员请求启动发动机，地面管制员发布了开车许可。随后，他要求686号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，两架飞机分别使用不同的无线电频率。塞斯纳开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右滑行并进入了R6滑行道。地面管制员没有意识到这一错误，仍许可塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员许可686号航班起飞。当686号航班正在跑道上滑跑时，塞斯纳越过跑道等待位置标志，进入了正在使用的36R跑道。遗憾的是，两架飞机相撞，机上114人全部遇难。
story-kongguan-004.referenceText: Q: what is this story about? Who should be blamed for this accident? What is the result of this accident?

story-kongguan-005.audioText: Flight 345 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and runway 22. There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind. That day, the tower controller cleared Flight 345 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 345 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 345 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 345. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.
story-kongguan-005.audioTextZh: 345号航班与101号航班险些在16号跑道和22号跑道的交叉口相撞。事故没有造成人员受伤，两架飞机也均未受损，但它被视为此类事件中最严重的一起。当天，塔台管制员许可345号航班在22号跑道着陆，但在许可101号航班从相交的16号跑道起飞时，忘记了这架正在进场的飞机。345号航班接地后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指示345号航班在16号跑道外停止，但飞机最终停在了跑道交叉口中央。101号航班已无法中断起飞，只得提前离地并从345号航班上方飞过。两架飞机仅以50英尺的间隔避免相撞。
story-kongguan-005.referenceText: Q: what happened between Flight 345&Flight 101? What was the controller’s instruction when he realize the two aircraft had conflict? What is the result of this event?

story-kongguan-006.audioText: As American Flight 835 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12 at that time, so the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach fro runway 30. But the crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on the runway 12. The runway was wet and braking action was not good. During landing roll, the aircraft skidded to the leftof the runway and went through the airport fences. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
story-kongguan-006.audioTextZh: 美国航空835号航班接近目的地终端区时，机组联系进近管制，并请求对12号跑道实施ILS进近。当时12号跑道报告有顺风，因此管制员建议飞行员进行盘旋进近，在30号跑道着陆。但机组坚持在12号跑道着陆，管制员随后许可其在12号跑道着陆。跑道湿滑，制动效应不佳。着陆滑跑期间，飞机向跑道左侧打滑并冲破机场围栏。机身断成三截，右发动机和右主起落架与机体分离。事故无人死亡，但许多乘客严重受伤。
story-kongguan-006.referenceText: Q: nature of the emergency? Weather and runway condition? Result?

story-kongguan-007.audioText: One day, Flight 123, a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to land at Tokyo International Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, flight 123 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the flight crew was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested the pilot divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to the alternate. So the controller vectored flight 123 by radar to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn’t stabilize the aircraft on the localizer due to wind shear. Flight 123 went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage. The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
story-kongguan-007.audioTextZh: 一天，123号航班，一架载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的B737，正在飞往东京国际机场着陆。当该航班从东京区调移交给东京进近时，由于空中交通拥堵，123号航班被指示飞往DA点等待。在等待期间，机组获悉当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降，但飞行员报告剩余燃油不足以飞到备降机场。因此，管制员对123号航班实施雷达引导，使其在34R跑道着陆。遗憾的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在航向道上稳定下来。123号航班复飞后进行了第二次进近。随后，飞机因燃油不足撞上山坡。飞机解体，机上所有人员全部遇难。

story-kongguan-008.audioText: One day, Indonesia 205 took off from Jinan to Hangzhou. About one hour later, the aircraft was transferred to Hangzhou Approach. Hangzhou Approach required Indonesia 205 to slow down to 190 knots and later the controller asked the pilot to reduce speed to 160 knots. Three minutes later, Indonesia 205 passed the outer marker inbound. At that time, the controller issued a missed approach clearance because of separation. He instructed Indonesia 205 to make a right turn to a heading of 180 and climb to 900m. But during the missed approach, the aircraft was out of control because of mechanical problem. The aircraft continued to descend with a high angle of attack. The aircraft impacted trees and buildings and part of the fuselage was damaged.
story-kongguan-008.audioTextZh: 一天，印度尼西亚航空205号航班从济南起飞前往杭州。大约一小时后，该航班被移交给杭州进近。杭州进近要求205号航班减速至190节，随后管制员又要求飞行员将速度减至160节。三分钟后，205号航班向台飞越外指点标。当时，管制员因间隔原因发布了复飞许可，指示205号航班右转至航向180度并爬升至900米。但在复飞过程中，飞机因机械故障失去控制，以大迎角状态持续下降。飞机撞上树木和建筑物，部分机身受损。

story-kongguan-009.audioText: One day, AFR188 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway, and crashed into the fence of the airport. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly injured. The plane was destroyed by the impact and caught on an intense fire. According to the investigation, there were three reasons leading to the accidents. First of all, the crew didn’t use effective methods to verify their position at the airport. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members’ idle chatting during the taxi resulted the loss of situational awareness.
story-kongguan-009.audioTextZh: 一天，AFR188在新加坡樟宜机场起飞期间坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组从02L跑道起飞，但机组却在02R跑道对正并开始起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道，撞上机场围栏。机组成员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶严重受伤。飞机因撞击而损毁，并燃起猛烈大火。调查显示，有三个原因导致了这起事故。首先，机组没有采用有效方法确认自己在机场内的位置。其次，机组忘记核实自己是否位于正确的跑道。最后，机组成员在滑行期间闲聊，导致情景意识丧失。

story-kongguan-010.audioText: One day, an A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage of its left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries. After receiving ATC taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room to pass over the B737. But unfortunately, two aircraft collided together with the wings. Both captains reported the collision immediately to the controller. Because the Boeing aircraft was damaged seriously, fuel leakage was reported and fire services were required. Fortunately, the fuel leak didn’t develop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes applied when they were hit.
story-kongguan-010.audioTextZh: 一天，一架A320与一架B737在滑行期间相撞。B737的右副翼严重受损，而A320的左翼仅轻微受损。幸运的是，没有人员受伤。收到空中交通管制的滑行指令后，A320开始从B737右侧通过。A320机长认为有足够空间可以从B737旁边通过，但两架飞机的机翼不幸发生碰撞。两位机长立即向管制员报告了相撞情况。由于波音飞机受损严重，机组报告发生燃油泄漏并请求消防救援。幸运的是，泄漏的燃油没有起火。波音飞机机组表示，他们被撞时一直停在原地，并已设置停留刹车。

story-kongguan-011.audioText: A pilot of Air China airline company told us an event with landing gear problem several days ago. After normal pushback, startup and taxi, he requested takeoff at the holding point of the active runway. However, he was instructed to hold short of the runway in order to give way to AFR123 on final. AFR123 declared emergency because of landing gear problem. AFR123 asked for a low pass to have a visual check. The controller verified the landing gear was still in up position during low pass. Then AFR123 requested a touch and go to jar the jammed gear. Unfortunately, after doing this, the landing gear still couldn’t be extended. So, AFR123 had to make a belly landing on a foamed runway. AFR123 made a safe landing. There were no casualties except some minor injuries.
story-kongguan-011.audioTextZh: 一名中国国际航空公司的飞行员向我们讲述了几天前发生的一起起落架故障事件。在正常完成推出、开车和滑行后，他在正在使用跑道的等待点请求起飞。然而，为了给最后进近中的AFR123让行，他被指示在跑道外等待。AFR123因起落架故障宣布紧急状态，并请求低空通场，以便从地面目视检查。低空通场期间，管制员确认起落架仍处于收上位置。随后，AFR123请求进行一次连续起飞，试图通过震动使卡住的起落架放下。遗憾的是，这样做之后起落架仍无法放出。因此，AFR123不得不在铺设了泡沫的跑道上实施机腹着陆。AFR123安全着陆，除少数人员轻伤外，没有其他伤亡。

story-kongguan-012.audioText: CSN341 was a flight from Beijing to Los Angles. When CSN341 initially contacted the tower controller, he was told the runway visual range was 500m. The pilot executed a missed approach two minutes later because of no contact at minima. Then, CSN341 was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. In the second approach, the controller issued landing clear to CSN341 at outer marker. One minute later, the controller observed the airplane was leaving the glide path on his radar display, so he issued missed approach instructions again. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted the top of a tall building and crashed. According to the investigation, the poor visibility made the pilot nervous and he misunderstood the missed approach instructions and made a wrong turn.
story-kongguan-012.audioTextZh: CSN341是一个从北京飞往洛杉矶的航班。CSN341首次联系塔台管制员时，被告知跑道视程为500米。两分钟后，由于在最低标准处未能建立目视，飞行员实施复飞。随后，CSN341接受雷达引导，准备进行第二次ILS进近。第二次进近中，CSN341飞越外指点标时，管制员向其发布了着陆许可。一分钟后，管制员在雷达显示器上观察到飞机正在偏离下滑道，于是再次发布复飞指令。此后没有再收到飞行员的回答。飞机撞上一座高层建筑的顶部后坠毁。调查显示，低能见度使飞行员感到紧张，他误解了复飞指令并转向错误方向。

story-kongguan-013.audioText: This story is about runway incursion. One day, A B767 nearly collided with an A320 at New York Airport, which is operating with two intersecting runways. Although there was neither casualties nor aircraft damages for both aircraft, still the incident was regarded as one of the most serious incidents of this kind. The tower controller instructed B767 to land at runway 21, meanwhile, he cleared A320 to take off at runway 18. Just as B767 touched down, the ground radar system sounded the alarm. The tower controller realized the problem and instructed B767 to stop landing rolling immediately, trying to stay out of the intersection of runway 18. In spite of the effort, B767 could only stop in the middle of the intersecting runway. However, the pilot of A320 could not abort takeoff, and pulled up the aircraft in advance to avoid collision. They missed each other by only 60 feet.
story-kongguan-013.audioTextZh: 这个故事与跑道侵入有关。一天，一架B767与一架A320在纽约机场险些相撞，该机场使用两条相交跑道运行。虽然两架飞机均无人员伤亡或飞机损伤，这起事件仍被视为同类事件中最严重的一起。塔台管制员指示B767在21号跑道着陆，同时许可A320从18号跑道起飞。就在B767接地时，地面雷达系统发出警报。塔台管制员意识到问题后，立即指示B767停止着陆滑跑，试图使其停在18号跑道交叉口之外。尽管采取了措施，B767最终只能停在相交跑道的中央。A320飞行员此时已无法中断起飞，只得提前拉起飞机避免相撞。两架飞机仅以60英尺的间隔擦肩而过。

story-kongguan-014.audioText: It was a sunny day in 2010, a Delta Airline’s 767-300 departed from Shanghai Pudong International Airport to Seoul. It carried 256 passengers and 13 crew members on board. During takeoff rolling, an unknown foreign object was sucked into port engine and the engine fire warning light illuminated. Then the flight crew declared an emergency right after airborne and completed the emergency checklist procedure. Through good communication, the controller understood the flight crew wanted to return to land. But the pilot had to dump fuel before landing because the aircraft was overweight to land. So the controller vectored the aircraft by radar to the dumping area. After circling over the sea and dumping fuel for almost one hour, the plane returned to land at departure airport safely.
story-kongguan-014.audioTextZh: 2010年一个晴朗的日子，达美航空一架767-300从上海浦东国际机场起飞前往首尔，机上载有256名乘客和13名机组人员。起飞滑跑期间，一个不明外来物被吸入左发动机，发动机火警灯亮起。飞机离地后，机组立即宣布紧急状态，并完成紧急检查单程序。通过良好沟通，管制员了解到机组希望返场着陆。但由于飞机重量超过着陆限制，飞行员必须在着陆前放油。因此，管制员对飞机实施雷达引导，前往放油区。飞机在海上盘旋并放油近一小时后，安全返回起飞机场着陆。

story-kongguan-015.audioText: One day, a B737 flew into the terminal control area of its destination airport. After establishing contact with Approach control, the flight crew requested clearance for ILS approach runway 22. During the approach, the controller suggested the flight crew make a circling to land on runway 04 because strong tailwind on runway 22 was just reported by previous A330. But the crew insisted on using runway 22, so the controller gave them clearance to land on runway 22. It was at night, the runway was scattered with snow and ice. Unfortunately, the plane missed the proper landing point on the runway, overran the runway and crashed into the fence of the airport. The fuselage was broken into three parts with the starboard engine separated from the wing. Fortunately, there were no killings, but many passengers were seriously injured.
story-kongguan-015.audioTextZh: 一天，一架B737进入目的地机场的终端管制区。与进近管制建立联系后，机组请求获准对22号跑道实施ILS进近。进近期间，由于前一架A330刚刚报告22号跑道有强顺风，管制员建议机组实施盘旋，在04号跑道着陆。但机组坚持使用22号跑道，管制员随后许可其在22号跑道着陆。当时正值夜间，跑道上散布着冰雪。遗憾的是，飞机错过了跑道上的适当接地点，冲出跑道并撞上机场围栏。机身断成三截，右发动机与机翼分离。幸运的是，事故没有造成人员死亡，但许多乘客严重受伤。

story-kongguan-016.audioText: In November 1996 I was in a flight flying to New York. I was in the flight because I got a call from New York Hospital that a heart would be ready for me. The pilot called the tower and told them who we were. The ATC said we could not land because President Clinton was there and the security service would not let us land. The pilot told the ATC that he would report this to the press and TV stations. I think they would let us land because of the bad influence. However, it didn’t work because the controllers wanted to have a look of Clinton. So we had to divert to the alternate airport instead. Fortunately, I got to the hospital on time. It was a great heart as you can see I am still alive almost 11 years after the operation. (145 words)
story-kongguan-016.audioTextZh: 1996年11月，我乘坐一个飞往纽约的航班。我之所以搭乘该航班，是因为接到纽约医院的电话，得知已经有一颗可供我移植的心脏。飞行员呼叫塔台并说明了我们的身份。空中交通管制员表示，由于克林顿总统当时在那里，安保部门不允许我们着陆。飞行员告诉管制员，他会把这件事报告给报社和电视台。我原以为他们会顾及不良影响而允许我们着陆，但这并没有奏效，因为管制员们想看一眼克林顿。因此，我们只得改降备降机场。幸运的是，我及时赶到了医院。那是一颗非常好的心脏——正如你所见，手术过去将近11年后，我仍然活着。（145词）

story-kongguan-017.audioText: On February 17th, 2005, United airline 123, an Airbus 320, collided with Air China 321, a Boeing 737, during taxi in the run-up area at the north end of runway 19. The right aileron of the Boeing 737 was severely damaged; the left wing of the Airbus 320 had minor damage. There were no injuries. The pilot of the Airbus 320 reported that he was positioned to the right of the Boeing 737. ATC cleared them for departure, which required them to taxi past the Boeing 737. The captain stated that he checked the position of the Boeing 737, and he thought he could clear it and then felt the impact. The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire. The crew of the Boeing 737 reported that they were stationary with the parking brake applied while awaiting ATC clearance. (150 words)
story-kongguan-017.audioTextZh: 2005年2月17日，美联航123号航班，一架空客A320，在19号跑道北端的试车区滑行时，与中国国际航空321号航班的一架波音737相撞。波音737的右副翼严重受损，空客A320的左翼轻微受损，没有人员受伤。A320飞行员报告称，其飞机当时位于B737右侧。空中交通管制许可他们离场，这要求A320从B737旁边滑过。机长表示，他检查了B737的位置，认为能够安全通过，随后便感受到了撞击。机长将相撞情况通知了空中交通管制。机场消防人员赶到现场，但没有发生燃油泄漏或火灾。B737机组报告称，他们当时设置了停留刹车，停在原地等待空中交通管制许可。（150词）

story-kongguan-018.audioText: The crew of flight 523 found a traffic 20 miles at FL 294 right ahead of the airplane on TCAS at FL 290 near LAMEN. The captain reported to Shanghai Control immediately, but the controller responded that there was no indication on his radar screen and there had not been any flight advisory. The captain then instructed the crew to turn left and found the conflicting traffic closing to the flight path and a TCAS warning was initiated. The crew then immediately turns right for avoidance, disengage the autopilot and descended to a lower altitude. The crew reported to the controller about the conflict after the conflict had been cleared.
story-kongguan-018.audioTextZh: 523号航班机组在LAMEN附近以FL290飞行时，通过TCAS发现飞机正前方20海里处有一架位于FL294的航空器。机长立即向上海管制报告，但管制员回应称，雷达屏幕上没有相关显示，此前也没有收到任何飞行情报。随后，机长指示机组左转，并发现冲突航空器正不断接近本机航迹，TCAS警告随即触发。机组立即右转避让，断开自动驾驶并下降到较低高度。冲突解除后，机组向管制员报告了此次冲突。

story-kongguan-019.audioText:
On September 28, 2003, United 552, a DC-9-82, experienced an in-flight engine fire during departure climb from New York City. During the return to the departure airport, the nose landing gear failed to extend, and the flight crew was instructed by the ATC to execute a go-around, during which the crew extended the nose gear using the emergency procedure. The flight crew conducted an emergency landing, and the 2 flight crewmembers, 3 flight attendants, and 138 passengers deplaned on the runway. No occupant injuries were reported, but the airplane sustained substantial damage from the fire.
The National Transportation Safety Board determines that the probable cause of this accident was American Airlines’ maintenance personnel’s use of an inappropriate manual engine-start procedure, which led to the subsequent left engine fire. (128 words)
story-kongguan-019.audioTextZh: 2003年9月28日，美联航552号航班，一架DC-9-82，在从纽约市起飞爬升期间发生空中发动机火警。飞机返航起飞机场期间，前起落架无法放出，空中交通管制指示机组复飞；复飞过程中，机组使用应急程序放出了前起落架。机组随后实施紧急着陆，2名飞行机组成员、3名乘务员和138名乘客在跑道上撤离。机上人员均未受伤，但飞机因火灾严重受损。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是美国航空维修人员采用了不适当的人工启动发动机程序，进而引发左发动机火灾。（128词）

story-kongguan-020.audioText: On March 22, 2008, China Southern 303, a Boeing 757-200, lost a left upper wing trailing edge panel during cruise flight at FL270. Initially, ATC received a pilot report that the flight crew had experienced "light chop" at the time. The flight was en route from Greenyard Airport to Blueyard Airport. The broken panel struck the window of passenger row 19ABC and cracked only the outer portion of the window. Pressurization was not lost. The flight crew continued on to Blueyard. Upon approach to Blueyard, ATC instructed the flight crew to expedite for separation. the flight crew informed ATC that they could not increase their airspeed due to possible airframe damage. The flight landed safely. There were 174 passengers and 6 crew members on board with no reported injuries.(128 words)
story-kongguan-020.audioTextZh: 2008年3月22日，中国南方航空303号航班，一架波音757-200，在FL270巡航时，左翼上表面的一块后缘面板脱落。最初，空中交通管制收到飞行员报告称，机组当时遭遇了“轻度颠簸”。该航班正从绿园机场飞往蓝园机场。脱落的面板击中了19ABC排乘客的舷窗，仅使舷窗外层开裂，飞机没有失压。机组继续飞往蓝园机场。飞机进近蓝园机场时，空中交通管制为建立间隔指示机组加快速度；机组告知管制员，由于机体可能受损，他们无法提高空速。航班最终安全着陆。机上共有174名乘客和6名机组人员，没有人员受伤报告。（128词）

story-kongguan-021.audioText:
On February 17, 2005, an Airbus 320 operated by United Airline, collided with an ERJ 145, operated by US Airways during taxi in the runup area of taxiway J at the north end of runway 19. The right aileron of the ERJ 145 was substantially damaged; the left winglet of the Airbus 320 had minor damage. There were no injuries.
The pilot of the Airbus 320 reported that he was positioned to the right of the ERJ 145. ATC cleared them for departure, which required them to taxi past the ERJ 145. The captain stated that he checked the proximity of the ERJ 145, and it looked like he could clear it and then felt the impact. The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire. The crew of the ERJ 145 reported that they were stationary with the parking brake applied while awaiting ATC clearance. (155 words)
story-kongguan-021.audioTextZh: 2005年2月17日，美联航运营的一架空客A320在19号跑道北端J滑行道试车区滑行时，与全美航空运营的一架ERJ145相撞。ERJ145的右副翼严重受损，空客A320的左翼梢小翼轻微受损，没有人员受伤。A320飞行员报告称，其飞机当时位于ERJ145右侧。空中交通管制许可他们离场，这要求A320从ERJ145旁边滑过。机长表示，他检查了与ERJ145之间的距离，认为能够安全通过，随后便感受到了撞击。机长将相撞情况通知了空中交通管制。机场消防人员赶到现场，但没有发生燃油泄漏或火灾。ERJ145机组报告称，他们当时设置了停留刹车，停在原地等待空中交通管制许可。（155词）

story-kongguan-022.audioText: Prior to initiating the first ILS approach to runway 10R, the pilot of Japan air 223 was advised by the tower controller that the runway visual range (RVR) was 600 feet, followed by being given a landing clearance. The pilot declared a missed approach two minutes later and was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. After turning inbound on the localizer, the pilot was advised the runway visual range and then cleared to land. When the tower controller observed the airplane turning to the south of the runway on her radar display, she issued missed approach instructions. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted the top of an 85-foot tall tree, and then continued to collide on the ground. The published missed approach procedure instructed the pilot to climb to 900 feet, then right turn to intercept the 160 degree radial of the VORTAC. It appears the pilot likely misinterpreted the missed approach instructions by making the right hand turn prior to initiating a climb to 900 feet, which resulted in the subsequent impact with the tree. (179 words)
story-kongguan-022.audioTextZh: 日本航空223号航班的飞行员在开始对10R跑道实施第一次ILS进近前，塔台管制员告知其跑道视程（RVR）为600英尺，随后向其发布了着陆许可。两分钟后，飞行员宣布复飞，并接受雷达引导进行第二次ILS进近。转入航向道向台飞行后，飞行员再次获知跑道视程，随后获准着陆。当塔台管制员在雷达显示器上观察到飞机正在向跑道南侧转弯时，她发布了复飞指令。此后没有再收到飞行员的回答。飞机撞上一棵85英尺高的大树顶部，随后继续撞击地面。公布的复飞程序要求飞行员先爬升至900英尺，然后右转切入VORTAC的160度径向线。飞行员很可能误解了复飞指令，在开始爬升至900英尺之前就进行了右转，最终导致飞机撞树。（179词）

story-kongguan-023.audioText: On February 28, 2001, A Boeing 757 and a Bombardier were substantially damaged when the tails of both airplanes collided during the pushback process from two adjacent terminal gates in Greenyard airport. The flight crew of the Bombardier reported that during the final stages of pushback from gate 79, they were in a stopped position while their ground crew was in the process of disconnecting the tug when the collision occurred. Company maintenance personnel stated they were pushing the 757 back from gate 80 and did not see the Bombardier. Review of ATC communication recordings between ground control and both airplanes revealed that the 757 was initially cleared for pushback onto taxiway alpha from gate 80. About 41 seconds later, the ground controller cleared the Bombardier to push back onto taxiway alpha from gate 79. The recordings revealed that the ground controller did not advise either aircraft of simultaneous adjacent pushback operations. The controller stated that he believed there was room for both aircraft to push back and did not forecast a traffic conflict. (174 words)
story-kongguan-023.audioTextZh: 2001年2月28日，在绿园机场两个相邻机位推出过程中，一架波音757和一架庞巴迪飞机的尾部发生碰撞，两架飞机均严重受损。庞巴迪机组报告称，他们从79号机位推出进入最后阶段时，飞机已经停住，地面人员正在断开牵引车，此时碰撞发生。航空公司维修人员表示，他们正将757从80号机位推出，没有看到庞巴迪飞机。对地面管制与两架飞机之间的空中交通管制通信录音进行审查后发现，757最初获准从80号机位推出至A滑行道。约41秒后，地面管制员又许可庞巴迪飞机从79号机位推出至A滑行道。录音显示，地面管制员没有向任何一架飞机通报相邻机位同时推出的情况。该管制员表示，他认为两架飞机都有足够的推出空间，没有预见到交通冲突。（174词）
