story-kongguan-077.audioText:
On Oct. 20th 2018，A Philippine Airlines Airbus 340, performing flight PR-117 from Vancouver to Manila, was accelerating for takeoff from Vancouver's runway 08 right when the tower controller heard a loud boom. The aircraft continued takeoff, climbed out and continued the flight.

The controller closed the runway for an inspection, which found tyre debris as well as other debris on the runway. The crew was advised via air traffc controller. The runway was closed for about 15 minutes until the debris had been cleaned up. The aircraft landed in Manila without further incident.

The Canadian Transportation Safety Board reported after landing in Manila several holes were found in the fuselage skin in the landing gear area. There was substantial damage to the belly as well as the center landing gear fairing door. The occurrence was rated an accident, however, no investigation was opened.
story-kongguan-077.audioTextZh:
2018年10月20日，一架菲律宾航空空客A340执行从温哥华飞往马尼拉的PR-117航班。飞机在温哥华机场08右跑道加速起飞时，塔台管制员听到一声巨响。飞机继续起飞、爬升并继续航程。

管制员关闭跑道进行检查，在跑道上发现轮胎碎片和其他残骸。管制员将情况通知机组。跑道关闭约15分钟，直到残骸清理完毕。飞机随后在马尼拉安全着陆，没有发生进一步事件。

加拿大运输安全委员会报告，飞机在马尼拉着陆后，检查发现起落架区域的机身蒙皮上有多个孔洞，机腹和中部起落架整流罩舱门严重受损。事件被定性为事故，但未启动调查。

story-kongguan-078.audioText:
On Apr 24th 2017, a South African Airways Airbus 319, undertaking scheduled flight Sierra-64 from Johannesburg to Lusaka, was in the initial climb out of Johannesburg's runway 03L when the crew requested to cease the climb at 8000 feet and commence a hold reporting they had a nose wheel problem.

Some rubber debris came out and the crew believed the debris had departed one of their nosewheels. The aircraft performed a low approach to runway 21 left about 40 minutes after departure, slightly offset to the left to overfly taxiway Yankee for an inspection from the ground, ground observers reported a left hand nose tyre had blown out, the right hand tyre was still intact.

The aircraft subsequently positioned for an approach to runway 21 right, landed safely, vacated the runway and stopped for an inspection by emergency services.
story-kongguan-078.audioTextZh:
2017年4月24日，一架南非航空空客A319执行从约翰内斯堡飞往卢萨卡的Sierra-64定期航班。飞机从约翰内斯堡机场03L跑道起飞初始爬升时，机组报告前轮有问题，请求在8,000英尺停止爬升并进入等待。

飞机掉落了一些橡胶碎片，机组认为碎片来自其中一个前轮。起飞约40分钟后，飞机对21左跑道实施低空进近，并稍向左偏以飞越Yankee滑行道，供地面人员检查。地面观察人员报告左侧前轮轮胎爆裂，右侧轮胎仍完好。

随后飞机定位进近21右跑道，安全着陆并脱离跑道，之后停下接受应急服务人员检查。

story-kongguan-079.audioText:
On Apr. 12th 2017, a Delta Airlines Boeing 767, carrying out flight Lima-420 from New York to Accra with 250 people on board, was accelerating for takeoff from New York's runway 13 right when the crew rejected takeoff due to disagreeing airspeeds.

The crew advised they didn't need assistance at this time and they were ready to return to the gate. The aircraft vacated the runway via taxiway Lima about 2700 meters down the runway and taxied via taxiway Alpha around the terminal complex and was near the intersection of taxiways Alpha and Whiskey when a ground observer notified Ground about flames from the back of the aircraft.

Ground subsequently advised the Delta crew there were flames from the right main gear, at least a strong glow, emergency services had already been dispatched. The aircraft stopped near the intersection taxiways Alpha and Whiskey. Emergency services foamed the right main gear and stamp the fire out. The passengers disembarked via mobile stairs after the fire was put out.
story-kongguan-079.audioTextZh:
2017年4月12日，一架达美航空波音767执行从纽约飞往阿克拉的Lima-420航班，机上共有250人。飞机在纽约机场13右跑道加速起飞时，因空速指示不一致中断起飞。

机组表示当时不需要协助，准备返回登机口。飞机在跑道上滑跑约2,700米后经Lima滑行道脱离，随后沿Alpha滑行道绕行航站区。当飞机接近Alpha与Whiskey滑行道交叉口时，一名地面观察人员向地面管制报告飞机尾部出现火焰。

地面管制随后通知达美机组，右主起落架处有火焰，至少可见强烈火光，应急服务车辆已经出动。飞机停在Alpha与Whiskey滑行道交叉口附近。应急人员向右主起落架喷洒泡沫并扑灭火焰。灭火后，乘客通过移动客梯下机。

story-kongguan-080.audioText:
On Aug 24th 2015, a Lufthansa Airbus 380, performing flight Hotel-401 from New York to Frankfurt, was enroute at flight level 370 about 220 miles northeast of Halifax when the crew decided to turn around and divert to Boston reporting oil fumes on board and the reducing engine oil quantity on the number 2 engine.

Cabin crew donned their smoke hoods. The aircraft dumped fuel on the way to Boston. Approaching Boston the flight crew reported one of the flight attendants was not feeling well and requested medical services available on arrival of the aircraft. The aircraft landed safely on Boston's runway 15 right about 90 minutes after turning around. The entire crew went to a hospital.

Preliminary information received indicates there had been a strong burning odour related to oil fumes as well as visible smoke in the cabin. All cabin crew donned their smoke hoods, the flight crew donned their oxygen masks. Two cabin crew felt very sick. After landing flight and cabin crew went to a hospital, passengers including babies needed medical attention as well. Maintenance determined an oil leak at number 2 engine.
story-kongguan-080.audioTextZh:
2015年8月24日，一架汉莎航空空客A380执行从纽约飞往法兰克福的Hotel-401航班。飞机在FL370飞行、位于哈利法克斯东北约220英里时，机组报告机上出现机油烟雾，且2号发动机机油量正在下降，因此决定返航并改航波士顿。

客舱机组戴上防烟面罩。飞机前往波士顿途中实施放油。接近波士顿时，飞行机组报告一名乘务员身体不适，请求飞机到达时提供医疗服务。飞机转向约90分钟后在波士顿机场15右跑道安全着陆，全部机组成员随后前往医院。

初步信息显示，客舱内有强烈的烧焦气味，与机油烟雾有关，同时还能看到烟雾。所有客舱机组戴上防烟面罩，飞行机组戴上氧气面罩。两名乘务员严重不适。着陆后，飞行机组和客舱机组均前往医院，包括婴儿在内的乘客也需要医疗照护。维修人员确定2号发动机存在机油泄漏。

story-kongguan-081.audioText:
On May 24th 2011, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 737, undertaking flight Whiskey-5421 from Omaha to Houston Hobby, was on approach to Houston's runway 13 right cleared to descend to 2000 feet and for a visual approach, when the crew reported a flaps failure and aborted the approach stopping the descent at 3000 feet.

The aircraft commenced a hold at 3000 feet while the crew was working the checklists, however without being able to resolve the flaps issue. The aircraft subsequently positioned for another high speed approach to runway 13 right and landed safely ( with 187 knots during touchdown ) about 45 minutes after the aborted approach. The aircraft slowed safely, vacated the runway and stopped, the crew requested emergency service to have a look at the hot brakes.

A replacement Boeing 737 continued the next sector to Albuquerque.The occurrencè aircraft returned to service 24 hours after landing.
story-kongguan-081.audioTextZh:
2011年5月24日，一架西南航空波音737执行从奥马哈飞往休斯顿霍比机场的Whiskey-5421航班。飞机进近休斯顿13右跑道，获准下降至2,000英尺并实施目视进近时，机组报告襟翼失效并中止进近，在3,000英尺停止下降。

飞机在3,000英尺进入等待，机组执行检查单，但未能排除襟翼故障。随后飞机重新定位，以高速进近13右跑道，并在中止进近约45分钟后安全着陆，接地速度为187节。飞机安全减速、脱离跑道并停下，机组请求应急服务人员检查过热的刹车。

另一架波音737替代执行下一航段前往阿尔伯克基。事发飞机在着陆24小时后恢复运行。

story-kongguan-082.audioText:
On May 22nd 2018, an Air Astana Airbus 320 performing flight Kilo-352 from Shymkent to Astana with 97 passengers and 9 crew, landed on Astana's runway 22 at 07:22 Zulu time but went right off the runway temporarily, crossed taxiways Bravo and Charlie and returned onto the center line of the runway. There were no injuries, the aircraft sustained damage to the left hand engine inlet.

Thunderstorms associated with winds gusting up to 49 knots were battering the city at that time causing a building crane to collapse, houses being unroofed and about 20 people on the ground being injured. Kazakhstan's Civil Aviation Department reported the aircraft went off the runway during roll out. The aircraft was towed to the apron. The airport was closed for about 40 minutes as result.

On Oct 18th 2018 Germany's BFU reported the left hand engine inlet and low pressure compressor were damaged when the aircraft exited the runway. The responsible pilot is German citizen, the BFU was therefore informed and joined the investigation.
story-kongguan-082.audioTextZh:
2018年5月22日，一架阿斯塔纳航空空客A320执行从奇姆肯特飞往阿斯塔纳的Kilo-352航班，机上有97名乘客和9名机组成员。飞机于07:22协调世界时在阿斯塔纳机场22号跑道着陆，但一度向右偏出跑道，穿过Bravo和Charlie滑行道后返回跑道中心线。无人受伤，飞机左发进气道受损。

当时，伴随最高49节阵风的雷暴正在袭击该市，造成一台建筑起重机倒塌、房屋屋顶被掀翻，约20名地面人员受伤。哈萨克斯坦民航部门报告，飞机在着陆滑跑中偏出跑道，之后被拖至机坪。机场因此关闭约40分钟。

2018年10月18日，德国航空事故调查局报告，飞机冲出跑道时左发进气道和低压压气机受损。由于责任机长是德国公民，德国航空事故调查局获知此事并参与调查。

story-kongguan-083.audioText:
On May 24th 2011, a United Air Boeing 737, performing flight Uniform-580 from Sochi to Moscow with 176 people on board, was climbing out of Sochi's runway 24 when the crew ceased the climb at flight level 200 due to a problem with the landing gear and decided to divert to Krasnodar, located about 100 miles north of Sochi. Luckily, the aircraft landed safely on runway 05 right about 65 minutes after departure from Sochi.

Krasnodar Airport reported the aircraft diverted to Krasnodar due to a technical malfunction. The airline reported the aircraft suffered a bird strike on departure, which damaged a sensor affecting the gear retraction. A replacement Boeing 737 reached Moscow with a delay of about 7 hours.

The occurrence aircraft departed Krasnodar about 12 hours after landing as flight Tango-9956, climbed to a maximum flight level 260 and positioned to Moscow Vnukovo. The aircraft is still on the ground in Vnukovo 3 hours after landing in Moscow.
story-kongguan-083.audioTextZh:
2011年5月24日，一架联合航空波音737执行从索契飞往莫斯科的Uniform-580航班，机上共有176人。飞机从索契机场24号跑道起飞爬升时，因起落架问题在FL200停止爬升，并决定改航至索契以北约100英里的克拉斯诺达尔。所幸，飞机从索契起飞约65分钟后在05右跑道安全着陆。

克拉斯诺达尔机场报告，飞机因技术故障改航。航空公司称，飞机起飞时遭遇鸟击，损坏了一个影响起落架收起的传感器。替换的波音737抵达莫斯科时延误约7小时。

事发飞机着陆约12小时后，以Tango-9956航班号离开克拉斯诺达尔，最高爬升至FL260，调机飞往莫斯科伏努科沃机场。抵达莫斯科3小时后，该机仍停留在伏努科沃地面。

story-kongguan-084.audioText:
On Sep 26th 2018, an Air Transat Airbus 310, performing flight Sierra-258 from Montreal to Barcelona with 205 passengers and 9 crew, was enroute at flight level 340 near the position about 410 miles west of Shannon when the aircraft encountered clear air turbulence causing serious injuries to a passenger and minor injuries to two passengers and two cabin crew.

The aircraft continued to Barcelona and landed in Barcelona about 2.5 hours later. The seriously injured passenger was taken to a hospital.

The Canadian Transportation Safety Board reported the aircraft encountered clear air turbulence, the autopilot disconnected and the aircraft climbed 300 feet very rapidly. The crew regained control and descended the aircraft to flight level 340. The fasten seat belt signs had not been illuminated due to lack of advanced indication.

The 4 minor injuries were treated on board, both cabin crew were able to continue duties. The aircraft was inspected after landing in Barcelona and was returned to service.
story-kongguan-084.audioTextZh:
2018年9月26日，一架越洋航空空客A310执行从蒙特利尔飞往巴塞罗那的Sierra-258航班，机上有205名乘客和9名机组成员。飞机在FL340飞行、位于香农以西约410英里时遭遇晴空颠簸，造成1名乘客重伤、2名乘客和2名客舱机组成员轻伤。

飞机继续飞往巴塞罗那，并于约2.5小时后着陆。重伤乘客被送往医院。

加拿大运输安全委员会报告，飞机遭遇晴空颠簸后自动驾驶断开，飞机迅速爬升300英尺。机组重新控制飞机并将其下降至FL340。由于事先没有任何征兆，当时安全带指示灯并未点亮。

4名轻伤人员在机上接受处理，两名受伤的客舱机组成员仍能够继续工作。飞机在巴塞罗那着陆后接受检查，随后恢复运行。

story-kongguan-085.audioText:
On Sep. 30th 2018, an Expressjet Embraer ERJ-145 on behalf of United, carrying out flight Xray-4104 from Chicago to Ottawa, was enroute at flight level 350 about 60 miles north of Rochester in Canadian Airspace when the crew requested to descend and several minutes later requested to divert to Rochester.

On approach to Rochester the aircraft was high for the approach, the crew however declined to increase the rate of descent and instead requested to fly a 360 (full circle) to lose height. Emergency services assumed their stand by positions for the arrival. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Rochester's runway 22 at a higher than normal speed about 35 minutes after leaving flight level 350.

A passenger reported the captain explained after landing they had problems with the elevator prompting the diversion to Rochester and on approach to Rochester a flaps failure resulting in the full circle. The competent authorities have joined forces with FAA to investigate.
story-kongguan-085.audioTextZh:
2018年9月30日，一架快捷航空巴航工业ERJ-145代表联合航空执行从芝加哥飞往渥太华的Xray-4104航班。飞机在加拿大空域FL350飞行、位于罗切斯特以北约60英里时，机组请求下降；几分钟后又请求改航罗切斯特。

进近罗切斯特时，飞机高度偏高。机组拒绝增加下降率，改为请求做一个360度整周盘旋以降低高度。应急服务人员就位待命。飞机离开FL350约35分钟后，以高于正常的速度在罗切斯特机场22号跑道安全着陆。

一名乘客称，机长在着陆后解释，升降舵出现问题促使飞机改航罗切斯特；进近罗切斯特时又发生襟翼故障，因此实施整周盘旋。主管部门已与美国联邦航空局联合调查。

story-kongguan-086.audioText:
On Sep 1st 2018, a United Air Boeing 737, performing flight Tango-579 from Moscow to Sochi with 164 passengers and 6 crew, landed on Sochi's runway 06 at 23:57 Zulu time but overran the end of the runway and came to a stop in a river bed past the runway.

The aircraft was initially vectored for an approach to runway 02 by approach, however, runway assignment was changed to runway 06 due to the weather developing. The aircraft aborted the first approach to Sochi's runway 06 descending through about 2300 feet due to changing winds. He positioned for another approach to runway 06 and went around from about 400 feet again due to changing winds.

After the aircraft overran the runway, his landing gear and wings collapsed, the left engine ignited. The aircraft was evacuated, 18 occupants were injured, the others remained unhurt, one airport worker died of a heart attack. The aircraft received substantial damage beyond repair.
story-kongguan-086.audioTextZh:
2018年9月1日，一架联合航空波音737执行从莫斯科飞往索契的Tango-579航班，机上有164名乘客和6名机组成员。飞机于23:57协调世界时在索契机场06号跑道着陆，但冲出跑道末端，最终停在跑道外的河床中。

进近管制最初雷达引导飞机进近02号跑道，但因天气变化，使用跑道改为06号跑道。飞机下降通过约2,300英尺时，因风向变化中止对06号跑道的首次进近。飞机再次定位进近06号跑道，又因风向变化从约400英尺复飞。

飞机冲出跑道后，起落架和机翼折断，左发起火。机上人员撤离，18人受伤，其余人员未受伤；一名机场工作人员因心脏病发作死亡。飞机严重受损，已无法修复。

story-kongguan-087.audioText:
On Sep 14th 2011, an Alitalia Airbus 320 carried out flight Alpha-1358 from Trieste to Rome with 98 people on board.

When he was in the initial climb out of Trieste's runway 27, the aircraft flew through a flock of birds and experienced a jolt prompting the crew to level off at 2300 feet and return to Trieste for a safe landing on runway 09 about 11 minutes after departure.

Passengers reported the aircraft had just become airborne when there was a huge jolt. Soon after the captain announced they had been hit by a flock of birds that had hit both engines, and they were returning to Trieste.

The flight was cancelled, the passengers were rebooked onto the next flights. The subsequent inspection found there was blood and feather inside the number one engine. It was really fortune that the engine was not out of order.
story-kongguan-087.audioTextZh:
2011年9月14日，一架意大利航空空客A320执行从的里雅斯特飞往罗马的Alpha-1358航班，机上共有98人。

飞机从的里雅斯特机场27号跑道起飞初始爬升时穿过鸟群，并受到一次强烈冲击，机组因此在2,300英尺改平并返回的里雅斯特；飞机起飞约11分钟后在09号跑道安全着陆。

乘客报告，飞机刚离地就出现一次剧烈震动。不久后，机长广播称飞机遭遇鸟群，两台发动机都受到鸟击，飞机将返回的里雅斯特。

航班被取消，乘客改签后续航班。随后检查发现1号发动机内部有血迹和羽毛。幸运的是，发动机并未失效。

story-kongguan-088.audioText:
On May. 1st 2014, a Vim Airlines Boeing 737 undertook charter flight Mike-9945 from Riga Latvia to Ufa Russia with about 40 passengers and 7 crew.

When the aircraft was about to accelerate for takeoff from runway 18 at about 10:00 Zulu time ,he began to yaw right turning about 90 degrees off the runway center line, skidded sideways, departed the right hand runway edge, and then collided with runway signs and a RVR sensor. Finally, the aircraft became disabled on the runway.

There were no injuries. The right hand engine, right hand wing leading edge and the left hand engine inlet received damage. The runway was closed for about 2 hours. Ground observer reported that there appeared to be a problem with the right hand engine, the aircraft veered right, went off the runway onto soft ground and subsequently managed to re-enter the runway.
story-kongguan-088.audioTextZh:
2014年5月1日，一架维姆航空波音737执行从拉脱维亚里加飞往俄罗斯乌法的Mike-9945包机航班，机上约有40名乘客和7名机组成员。

约10:00协调世界时，飞机准备在18号跑道加速起飞时开始向右偏航，机头相对跑道中心线转过约90度。飞机侧滑，冲出跑道右侧边缘，随后撞上跑道标志牌和一个跑道视程（RVR）传感器，最终失去移动能力并停在跑道上。

事件无人受伤。飞机右发、右翼前缘以及左发进气道受损，跑道关闭约2小时。地面观察人员报告，右发似乎出现问题，飞机向右偏转，冲出跑道进入松软地面，随后又设法回到跑道。

story-kongguan-089.audioText:
On Apr. 25th 2017, an Easyjet Airbus 320, performing flight Uniform-5831 from Berlin Tegel to Tel Aviv, was in the initial climb out of Tegel's runway 26 left when the crew ceased the climb at 3500 feet due to being unable to retract the landing gear.

The aircraft returned to Berlin Tegel for a safe landing on runway 26 right about 40 minutes after departure. A replacement A320 reached Tel Aviv with a delay of 6.5 hours. The occurrence aircraft is still on the ground in Berlin about 39 hours after landing back.

A passenger reported shortly after takeoff they perceived abnormal wind rush sounds, then realized they had stopped climbing. After a while the captain announced that they were unable to retract the landing gear and would return to Berlin. A replacement aircraft and crew was flown in from Berlin Schoenefeld Germany.

2017年4月25日，一架易捷航空空客A320执行从柏林泰格尔飞往特拉维夫的Uniform-5831航班。飞机从泰格尔机场26左跑道起飞初始爬升时，因起落架无法收起在3,500英尺停止爬升。

飞机起飞约40分钟后返回柏林泰格尔，并在26右跑道安全着陆。替换的A320抵达特拉维夫时延误6.5小时。返航着陆约39小时后，事发飞机仍停留在柏林地面。

一名乘客称，起飞后不久听到异常的强烈气流声，随后发现飞机停止爬升。过了一会儿，机长广播说起落架无法收起，飞机将返回柏林。航空公司从德国柏林舍讷费尔德调来替换飞机和机组。

story-kongguan-090.audioText:
On Jun. 2nd 2015, an American Airlines Boeing 777 performing flight Alpha-101 from London Heathrow to New York with 206 passengers and 13 crew, was enroute at flight level 320 about 20 miles southeast of Shannon when the crew reported they needed to divert to their Alternate, because they had a left engine fire.

The crew worked the related checklists, shut the engine down and discharged the fire bottle. The aircraft turned around, drifted down and diverted to Dublin Ireland. Air traffic controller asked whether they were able to vacate runway 28 at Bravo 7, because emergency services would check them at Bravo 7, the crew agreed they could do that.

On final approach the crew advised in case of a go-around they'd climb out straight at runway heading to 2000 feet. The aircraft landed on runway 28 without further incident. Ground control as well as emergency services reported seeing no smoke from the left engine. The airline reported the aircraft diverted due to an indication of a possible mechanical issue.
story-kongguan-090.audioTextZh:
2015年6月2日，一架美国航空波音777执行从伦敦希思罗飞往纽约的Alpha-101航班，机上有206名乘客和13名机组成员。飞机在FL320飞行、位于香农东南约20英里时，机组报告左发起火，需要改航至备降机场。

机组执行相关检查单，将发动机关车并释放灭火瓶。飞机转弯、飘降，并改航爱尔兰都柏林。管制员询问飞机能否在Bravo 7脱离28号跑道，因为应急服务人员将在Bravo 7对飞机进行检查；机组确认可以。

最后进近时，机组说明若复飞，将沿跑道航向直线爬升至2,000英尺。飞机在28号跑道安全着陆，没有发生进一步事件。地面管制和应急服务人员均报告未看到左发冒烟。航空公司称，飞机因可能存在机械问题的指示而改航。

story-kongguan-091.audioText:
On Dec. 12th 2017, a US-Bangla Boeing 737 carried out scheduled flight Sierra-141 from Dhaka to Cox's Bazar with 164 passengers and 7 crew.

During the final approach to Cox's Bazar's runway 17 , the crew went around from about 1500 feet after receiving indication the nose gear had not extended. The aircraft climbed to 3000 feet, the crew worked the related checklists and performed another low approach to Cox's Bazar's runway 17 to have the nose gear checked from the ground which confirmed the nose gear was not down.

The crew decided to divert to Chittagong, about 50 miles north of Cox's Bazar, and prepared for a landing without nose gear. The aircraft landed on Chitagong's runway 23 and came to a stop on the runway on the main gear and the aircraft nose. The aircraft was evacuated. No injuries are being reported.
story-kongguan-091.audioTextZh:
2017年12月12日，一架孟加拉优速航空波音737执行从达卡飞往科克斯巴扎尔的Sierra-141定期航班，机上有164名乘客和7名机组成员。

飞机最后进近科克斯巴扎尔机场17号跑道时，收到前起落架未放下的指示，机组从约1,500英尺复飞。飞机爬升至3,000英尺，机组执行相关检查单，并再次对17号跑道实施低空进近，让地面人员检查前起落架；检查确认前起落架未放下。

机组决定改航至科克斯巴扎尔以北约50英里的吉大港，并准备在没有前起落架的情况下着陆。飞机在吉大港机场23号跑道着陆，以主起落架和机头支撑，最终停在跑道上。机上人员撤离，无人受伤。

story-kongguan-092.audioText:
On Sep 21st 2018, an Iberia Airbus 350 performing flight India-6252 from New York to Madrid Spain with 265 passengers and 11 crew, was enroute at flight level 410 about 70 miles southeast of Halifax Canada when the crew reported they had needed to shut the left hand engine down.

The aircraft drifted down to flight level 250, then turned around. The crew decided to return to New York's JFK Airport, but when already cleared direct to New York Airport they changed their mind to divert to Boston. The aircraft was recleared direct to Boston. The crew advised they would be able to vacate the runway, and no assistance was needed. The aircraft landed on Boston's runway 33 left about 96 minutes after leaving flight level 410, vacated the runway and taxied to the apron with emergency services in trail.

On Sep 24th 2018 the Canadian Transportation Safety Board reported the crew received a ” ENGINE ONE EGT OVER LIMIT” indication followed by an “ENGINE ONE FAIL” message during flight.
story-kongguan-092.audioTextZh:
2018年9月21日，一架伊比利亚航空空客A350执行从纽约飞往西班牙马德里的India-6252航班，机上有265名乘客和11名机组成员。飞机在FL410飞行、位于加拿大哈利法克斯东南约70英里时，机组报告不得不将左发关车。

飞机飘降至FL250后返航。机组最初决定返回纽约肯尼迪机场，但在已获准直飞纽约机场后改变决定，改航波士顿，随后重新获准直飞波士顿。机组表示能够自行脱离跑道，不需要协助。飞机离开FL410约96分钟后，在波士顿机场33左跑道着陆，脱离跑道后在应急服务车辆跟随下滑行至机坪。

2018年9月24日，加拿大运输安全委员会报告，机组在飞行中先收到“1号发动机排气温度超限”指示，随后又收到“1号发动机失效”信息。

story-kongguan-093.audioText:
On Apr. 2nd 2013, a Lufthansa Cargo MD-11 performing flight Lima-8231 from Los Angeles to Frankfurt, was at flight level 370 enroute near London when first indications of a problem with the fuel pump system occurred.

After leaving cruise level on descent into Frankfurt the crew advised they might not be able to access all available fuel and thus may be short on fuel. Emergency services deployed to their stand by positions at Frankfurt, the aircraft landed safely on Frankfurt's runway 25 left about 50 minutes after the first problems surfaced and about 15 minutes after the crew selected the emergency transponder code.

The airport reported the crew made a precautionary, not an emergency landing advising of a problem with the fuel supply systems. It is unclear whether sufficient fuel had been loaded in Los Angeles.

The airline reported the crew received a warning indication about one hour prior to landing of a possible problem in one of the multiple fuel supply lines. The crew declared emergency to receive priority, emergency services were therefore called out for the landing. The aircraft landed safely and taxied to the parking position.
story-kongguan-093.audioTextZh:
2013年4月2日，一架汉莎货运MD-11执行从洛杉矶飞往法兰克福的Lima-8231航班。飞机在伦敦附近以FL370巡航时，首次出现燃油泵系统故障指示。

飞机离开巡航高度向法兰克福下降后，机组报告可能无法使用机上全部可用燃油，因此可能出现燃油不足。法兰克福机场应急服务人员到待命位置。飞机在首次出现问题约50分钟、机组选择紧急应答机编码约15分钟后，在法兰克福机场25左跑道安全着陆。

机场报告称，机组因燃油供应系统问题实施的是预防性着陆，而非紧急着陆。尚不清楚飞机在洛杉矶是否装载了足够燃油。

航空公司报告，机组在着陆前约1小时收到警告，显示多条燃油供应管路中的一条可能出现问题。机组为获得优先权宣布紧急情况，因此应急服务人员出动保障着陆。飞机安全着陆并滑行至停机位。

story-kongguan-094.audioText:
On Nov. 29th 2017, a United Boeing 737 performing flight Alpha-326 from Washington to Seattle, reported ready for departure and was instructed to line up runway 19 Center and wait. Tower controller advised there were a couple of runway crossings ahead of their departure.

About 40 seconds later Tower cleared Alpha-326 for takeoff, the aircraft commenced its takeoff roll at some stage. About 40 seconds after the takeoff clearance Tower cleared two aircraft to cross runway 19 Center. When the crew of Alpha-326 saw one of the aircraft on the runway they rejected takeoff and announced they were seeing an aircraft on the runway.

Tower queried whether they had been cleared to takeoff, the crew affirmed they had received clearance for takeoff. The second aircraft cleared to cross had stopped ahead of the runway. Tower cancelled the takeoff clearance, instructed Alpha-326 to vacate the runway and cleared the two crossing aircraft to continue crossing.

Alpha-326 was able to depart about 15 minutes later, was cleared for departure by the same controller, and reached Seattle on time.
story-kongguan-094.audioTextZh:
2017年11月29日，一架联合航空波音737执行从华盛顿飞往西雅图的Alpha-326航班。机组报告准备起飞后，被指令进入19中跑道并等待。塔台管制员提醒，起飞前还有几架飞机需要穿越跑道。

约40秒后，塔台许可Alpha-326起飞，飞机随后开始起飞滑跑。起飞许可发布约40秒后，塔台又许可两架飞机穿越19中跑道。Alpha-326机组看到其中一架飞机进入跑道后中断起飞，并报告看到跑道上有飞机。

塔台询问Alpha-326是否曾获起飞许可，机组确认已经收到起飞许可。第二架获准穿越跑道的飞机停在跑道外。塔台取消Alpha-326的起飞许可，指令其脱离跑道，并许可两架穿越飞机继续通过。

约15分钟后，Alpha-326由同一名管制员再次放行起飞，并准时抵达西雅图。

story-kongguan-095.audioText:
On Aug. 14th 2011, a Go2Sky Airline Boeing 737 on behalf of Czech Airlines, undertaking flight Kilo-508 from Prague to Copenhagen, was climbing out of Prague's runway 12 when air traffic controller issued a radar vector to turn left onto a heading of 360.

The aircraft however was on a heading of about 060, air traffic controller queried, the crew confirmed they were on heading 360. Shortly afterwards the crew reported they had lost all their primary navigation, they wanted to return and requested radar vectors to join the ILS, they would be able to maintain a heading using their stand by compass, no assistance was needed on the ground.

The crew stopped the climb at about fight level 125 and returned to Prague for a safe landing on runway 12 about 20 minutes after departure and taxied to the apron. The occurrence aircraft returned to service about 13 hours after landing back.

2011年8月14日，一架Go2Sky航空波音737代表捷克航空执行从布拉格飞往哥本哈根的Kilo-508航班。飞机从布拉格机场12号跑道起飞爬升时，管制员雷达引导其左转航向360度。

然而，飞机实际航向约为060度。管制员提出质疑，机组却确认其航向为360度。不久后，机组报告所有主要导航设备均已失效，希望返航，并请求雷达引导加入ILS进近。机组表示可以使用备用罗盘保持航向，地面不需要协助。

机组在约FL125停止爬升，飞机起飞约20分钟后返回布拉格，在12号跑道安全着陆并滑行至机坪。事发飞机返航着陆约13小时后恢复运行。

story-kongguan-096.audioText:
On Mar. 18th 2016, a Delta Airlines Boeing 767 performing flight Dlta-472 from Sao Paulo to New York, was descending towards New York when the crew reported a hydraulic failure and requested emergency services on stand by.

The aircraft continued for a safe landing on runway 31 left, the crew indicated they were able to vacate the runway and needed assistance afterwards, they would need to get towed to the apron. The aircraft vacated the runway and stopped.

The crew indicated the brakes temperatures were increasing, the crew shut the engines down while waiting for the tug, the brakes temperatures on the left hand brakes were still increasing beyond 700 degrees, the right hand side was "nicely" catching up, smoke began to rise from the brakes prompting emergency services to cool down the brakes.

The airport authority reported emergency services responded to a Delta 767 with a hydraulic failure causing overheated brakes. Emergency services handled the condition. The airline reported the aircraft landed safely and was towed to the apron due to a potential mechanical issue.

飞机继续进近并在31左跑道安全着陆。机组表示能够自行脱离跑道，但之后需要协助，并需由牵引车拖至机坪。飞机脱离跑道后停下。

机组报告刹车温度不断升高，在等待牵引车时关闭了发动机。左侧刹车温度继续升至700度以上，右侧刹车温度也快速追上。刹车开始冒烟，应急服务人员随即对刹车进行冷却。

机场当局报告，应急服务人员处置了一架因液压失效导致刹车过热的达美航空767。航空公司称，飞机因潜在机械故障安全着陆，随后被拖至机坪。

story-kongguan-097.audioText:
On Mar, 26th 2018, a Lufthansa Airbus 340 performing flight Lima-444 from Frankfurt to Atlanta, was climbing out of Frankfurt's runway 25 Center when the crew stopped the climb at flight level 100 reporting they had a "smell event" on board.

The crew indicated that the aircraft was completely okay, however, it was possible they would not continue the flight, they wanted to remain in the vicinity of the airport while troubleshooting. A number of passengers began to complain about nausea and dizziness.

About 20 minutes after levelling off at flight level 100 the crew advised their decision was taken. A number of crew reported being dizzy because of the odour, they didn't want to risk anything, they were therefore returning to Frankfurt, fuel dump was not necessary, time was more important, a normal landing was to be expected. The aircraft landed safely back on runway 25 Center about 40 minutes after departure.
story-kongguan-097.audioTextZh:
2018年3月26日，一架汉莎航空空客A340执行从法兰克福飞往亚特兰大的Lima-444航班。飞机从法兰克福机场25中跑道起飞爬升时，机组在FL100停止爬升，报告机上发生“异味事件”。

机组表示飞机本身完全正常，但可能不会继续航程，希望留在机场附近排查问题。多名乘客开始出现恶心和头晕症状。

飞机在FL100改平约20分钟后，机组报告已作出决定。多名机组成员因异味感到头晕，他们不愿冒险，因此决定返回法兰克福。机组表示无需放油，时间更为重要，预计可以正常着陆。飞机起飞约40分钟后安全返回，在25中跑道着陆。

story-kongguan-098.audioText:
On Nov. 15th 2017, a Delta Airlines Boeing 757 performing flight Delta-1658 from San Francisco to Detroit, was accelerating for takeoff from San Francisco's runway 01 Right when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed (about 123 knots over ground) due to a starboard engine fire indication.

The crew requested fire trucks to be rolled while the aircraft was still slowing down. Tower reported: "it does appear your left engine is on fire." Tower closed both runways 01 Right and 01 Left and instructed approaches to runways 28 Left and 28 Right to continue their approaches without issuing landing clearances, emergency services responded to runway 01 Right crossing runway 01 Left.

After it was clear the Boeing 757 had passed both runways 28, the approaches to 28 Left and 28 Right were cleared to land. Emergency services stamped out the fire and reported seeing no fire on the left hand side. The aircraft taxied to the apron about 20 minutes after the rejected takeoff.
story-kongguan-098.audioTextZh:
2017年11月15日，一架达美航空波音757执行从旧金山飞往底特律的Delta-1658航班。飞机在旧金山机场01右跑道加速起飞时，因右发火警指示以高速中断起飞，当时地速约123节。

飞机仍在减速时，机组请求消防车出动。塔台报告：“看起来你们的左发确实着火了。”塔台关闭01右和01左两条跑道，并指令进近28左和28右跑道的飞机继续进近，但暂不发布着陆许可。应急服务车辆穿越01左跑道，赶往01右跑道。

确认波音757已通过两条28跑道后，进近28左和28右跑道的飞机获准着陆。应急服务人员扑灭火焰，并报告左侧未见火情。飞机在中断起飞约20分钟后滑行返回机坪。

story-kongguan-099.audioText:
On Sep 17th 2018, a Canadian Airlines CRJ-200, carrying out flight Sierra-721 from Kathmandu to Biratnagar with 48 passengers and 4 crew, was climbing out of Kathmandu when the port engine ingested a bird.

In the absence of abnormal indications the crew decided to continue the flight to destination, however, about half way into the flight the left engine began to develop vibrations. The aircraft landed safely in Biratnagar.

A post flight inspection revealed two fan blades of the left engine were damaged requiring repair. As the second CRJ-200 of the airline is currently in maintenance, the airline needed to cancel all flights of Sep 17th 2018. The airport reported the crew did not advise of a bird strike, however, a dead bird was found on the runway after the departure.

Nepal's Civil Aviation Authority reported the crew was not sure about a bird strike, they had heard and felt something but couldn't identify what it was and as there were no abnormal indications they continued the flight.
story-kongguan-099.audioTextZh:
2018年9月17日，一架加拿大航空CRJ-200执行从加德满都飞往比拉特纳加尔的Sierra-721航班，机上有48名乘客和4名机组成员。飞机从加德满都起飞爬升时，左发吸入一只鸟。

由于没有任何异常指示，机组决定继续飞往目的地；但航程进行约一半时，左发开始出现振动。飞机最终在比拉特纳加尔安全着陆。

飞后检查发现左发两片风扇叶片受损，需要维修。由于航空公司的另一架CRJ-200当时正在检修，航空公司不得不取消2018年9月17日的全部航班。机场报告，机组没有报告鸟击，但该机起飞后在跑道上发现一只死鸟。

尼泊尔民航局报告，机组不确定是否发生了鸟击；他们听到并感觉到某种异常，但无法判断是什么。由于没有异常指示，机组继续了航班。

story-kongguan-100.audioText:
On Aug 26th 2018, an Air Canada Boeing 767 carried out flight Victor-1940 from Vancouver to Dublin with 257 passengers and 8 crew. When he was climbing through 10,000 feet out of Vancouver, a loud bang was heard from the right hand engine, the engine lost power and abnormal engine indications occurred.

The crew reduced the engine to idle, declared emergency and returned to Vancouver for a safe landing on Vancouver's runway 08 right about 25 minutes later. A runway inspection discovered debris on the runway, then the runway was closed.

The Canadian Transportation Safety Board rated the occurrence an accident but did not open an investigation. The TSB reported: "An initial visual inspection of the engine revealed extensive damage to the aftmost turbine blades. The inboard aileron and the fuselage just aft of the baggage door were punctured by debris. The engine was sent to the manufacturer for teardown and inspection. Root cause analysis is on-going."
story-kongguan-100.audioTextZh:
2018年8月26日，一架加拿大航空波音767执行从温哥华飞往都柏林的Victor-1940航班，机上有257名乘客和8名机组成员。飞机从温哥华起飞爬升通过10,000英尺时，右发传出一声巨响，随后发动机失去动力，并出现异常发动机指示。

机组将该发动机收至慢车，宣布紧急情况并返回温哥华；约25分钟后，飞机在温哥华机场08右跑道安全着陆。跑道检查发现跑道上有碎片，随后跑道关闭。

加拿大运输安全委员会将事件定性为事故，但未启动调查。委员会报告：“对发动机的初步目视检查发现，最后端的涡轮叶片严重受损。内侧副翼以及行李舱门后方的机身被碎片击穿。发动机已送往制造商拆解检查，根本原因分析仍在进行中。”

story-kongguan-101.audioText:
On Aug. 21st 2017, a Frontier Airlines Airbus 320 performing flight Foxtrot-452 from Denver to Washington, was in the initial climb out of Denver's runway 08 cleared to climb flight level 230 when the crew requested to level off at 10,000 feet due to a bird strike to figure out what is going on.

The crew decided to initially continue the departure route. The crew subsequently advised they were slowing to 250 knots, and they were already in the climb past the runway end when there was a really loud bang. The crew advised they would return as a precaution, no need to declare emergency, they needed to burn off some fuel, the crew commented it probably was a "duck on a bad day".

The aircraft entered a hold on the localizer runway 16 right, burned off fuel and landed safely back on Denver's runway 16 right about one hour after departure. A passenger reported the crew announced after landing that there was a large dent.
story-kongguan-101.audioTextZh:
2017年8月21日，一架边疆航空空客A320执行从丹佛飞往华盛顿的Foxtrot-452航班。飞机从丹佛机场08号跑道起飞初始爬升，获准爬升至FL230时，机组因鸟击请求在10,000英尺改平，以确认具体情况。

机组起初决定继续沿离场航路飞行，随后报告将减速至250节。机组称，飞机已爬升飞过跑道末端时听到一声巨响。为预防起见，机组决定返航，认为无需宣布紧急情况，但需要消耗部分燃油；机组还评论说，那可能是“一只倒霉的鸭子”。

飞机在16右跑道航向台上进入等待，消耗燃油后，于起飞约1小时后安全返回丹佛机场，在16右跑道着陆。一名乘客称，机组着陆后广播说飞机上有一个很大的凹痕。

story-kongguan-102.audioText:
On Sep. 12th 2016, a Skywest Canadair CRJ-200 on behalf of United performing flight Oscar-5480 from Chicago to Ottawa with 50 passengers and 3 crew, was descending towards Ottawa when the flight attendant observed an odour in the cabin near seat row 9 and identified the fumes originated from the overhead bin.

The flight crew declared emergency and expedited the approach. The captain advised the flight attendant it would be a normal landing, she should be ready for an evacuation however. The aircraft landed safely with emergency services on stand by.

The Canadian Transportation Safety Board reported emergency services found no trace of fire, heat, smoke or any source of the odour. The aircraft taxied to the apron. Maintenance tested both packs, the APU and both engines but did not find any anomaly. Maintenance concluded the smoke was result of water condensation from the lower air conditioning vent.
story-kongguan-102.audioTextZh:
2016年9月12日，一架天西航空加拿大区域喷气CRJ-200代表联合航空执行从芝加哥飞往渥太华的Oscar-5480航班，机上有50名乘客和3名机组成员。飞机向渥太华下降时，一名乘务员在客舱第9排座位附近闻到异味，并确认烟气来自头顶行李舱。

飞行机组宣布紧急情况并加速进近。机长告知乘务员将正常着陆，但应做好撤离准备。飞机在应急服务人员待命的情况下安全着陆。

加拿大运输安全委员会报告，应急人员没有发现任何着火、发热、烟雾痕迹，也未找到异味来源。飞机滑行至机坪。维修人员测试了两套空调组件、APU和两台发动机，均未发现异常。维修人员最终认定，烟雾是下部空调通风口产生的冷凝水所致。

story-kongguan-103.audioText:
On Oct 28th 2018, a Condor Boeing 757 performing flight Dlta-1440 from Hamburg to Ventura with 275 passengers and 8 crew, was being pushed back from the gate, when the engines were started.

An odour of "old socks" developed on board, that continued during taxi, departure and climb. Only after levelling off at cruise level the odour subsided. A number of passengers complained about headache, nausea and dizziness. The crew continued the flight to Ventura where the aircraft landed without further incident. At least two passengers required medical attention after landing.

Passengers described the odour as very strong like old or wet socks. Germany's BFU reported on Oct 29th 2018, that the occurrence was reported to them. Data collection is in progress to rate the occurrence.

The occurrence aircraft remained on the ground in Ventura for two hours, then departed for the return flight. The aircraft subsequently remained on the ground in Hamburg for about 9 hours and departed the following morning on schedule.
story-kongguan-103.audioTextZh:
2018年10月28日，一架神鹰航空波音757执行从汉堡飞往文图拉的Dlta-1440航班，机上有275名乘客和8名机组成员。飞机正在推出登机位时启动发动机。

机上随后出现一股“旧袜子”气味，并在滑行、起飞和爬升期间持续存在，直到飞机在巡航高度改平后才逐渐减弱。多名乘客出现头痛、恶心和眩晕。机组继续飞往文图拉，飞机安全着陆，没有发生进一步事件。着陆后至少有两名乘客需要医疗救治。

乘客形容异味非常强烈，像旧袜子或湿袜子的气味。德国航空事故调查局于2018年10月29日报告已收到该事件报告，正在收集数据以确定事件等级。

事发飞机在文图拉地面停留2小时后执行返程航班，随后在汉堡地面又停留约9小时，并于次日上午按计划起飞。

We have made great progress in reducing flight delay. 我们在减少航班延误上取得了巨大进步。
They asked for a progress report on the accident investigation. 他们索要事故调查进度报告。 Data collection is in progress to rate the occurrence. 给此事件定性的数据收集正在进行中。 We should start off declaring radar failure and then progress to ask for position report.（OPI雷达失效话题） 我们开始应该宣布雷达失效，然后要求位置报告（progress to do sth.接着做另外一件事）
nausea [ˈnɔ:ziə]：恶心，晕船
dizziness ['dɪzɪnɪs]：头晕，头晕眼花
dizzy ['dɪzɪ]：眩晕的 下面再来学几个机上突发疾病的一些常见单词 （动词用 suffer / complain of）
cold [kəʊld]：感冒
fever ['fiːvə]：发烧
flu [fluː]：流感
asthma ['æsmə]：支气管哮喘
vomit ['vɒmɪt]：呕吐
difficult breath：呼吸困难
bone fracture [bəʊn 'fræktʃə]：骨折
bleeding disorders ['bliːdɪŋ dɪs'ɔrdɚ]：流血不止
lightheaded ['laɪt'hedɪd]：头晕眼花的（ = dizzy）
diarrhea [,daɪə'riə]：腹泻

story-kongguan-104.audioText:
On Dec. 5th 2014, a Swiss Airbus 330 performing flight Lima-19 from Newark to Zurich with 166 passengers and 12 crew, was descending through flight level 340 about 100 miles southeast of Paris and about 160 miles northwest of Zurich when the crew increased the descent to an emergency descent due to the loss of cabin pressure.

The aircraft levelled off at flight level 100 and continued to Zurich, where the crew requested a shallow descent due to the cabin pressure problems and an extended downwind to accommodate the shallow descent. After levelling at 4000 feet on approach to Zurich's runway 14 the crew cancelled the emergency.

The aircraft landed safely on Zurich's runway 14 about 35 minutes after initiating the emergency descent and taxied to the apron. On Dec 9th 2014 the French BEA reported in their weekly bulletin, that the occurrence has been rated a serious incident and is being investigated by Switzerland's SUST.
story-kongguan-104.audioTextZh:
2014年12月5日，一架瑞士国际航空空客A330执行从纽瓦克飞往苏黎世的Lima-19航班，机上有166名乘客和12名机组成员。飞机下降通过FL340、位于巴黎东南约100英里且苏黎世西北约160英里时，因客舱失压将下降加大为紧急下降。

飞机在FL100改平后继续飞往苏黎世。由于客舱压力问题，机组请求采用小下降角，并延长三边以配合缓慢下降。进近苏黎世机场14号跑道期间，飞机在4,000英尺改平后，机组取消紧急状态。

飞机开始紧急下降约35分钟后，在苏黎世机场14号跑道安全着陆并滑行至机坪。2014年12月9日，法国航空事故调查局在每周通报中报告，该事件已被定性为严重事故征候，正由瑞士安全调查局调查。
story-kongguan-104.referenceText:
复诵逻辑框架：
2014.12.5 瑞士航空A330 L19—— 机载166名乘客 12名机组 纽瓦克市至苏黎世—— 由于座舱释压 紧急下降

FL100改平 继续飞往苏黎世—— 请求小角度下降和延长三边—— 4000ft 取消紧急情况

跑道14号 安全落地—— 2014.12.9 定性为严重事件 正调查

Newark ['nju:ək]：纽瓦克市（美国新泽西州）
Zurich [ˈzjʊərɪk]：苏黎世
Switzerland [ˈswɪtsələnd]：瑞士
weekly bulletin ['bʊlɪtɪn]：每周简报
the loss of cabin pressure = cabin depressurization = cabin decompression = cabin altitude rising fast：座舱释压
shallow descent：小角度下降（flat descent）
shallow banked turn：小角度转弯（转弯角度小于20度）
accommodate [ ə'kɒmədeɪt] ：容纳，使适应，考虑到，顾及，顺应，适应
The crew requested a shallow descent due to the cabin pressure problems and an extended downwind to accommodate the shallow descent. 由于座舱压力问题，机组请求小角度下降以及为此延长三边。
Controllers’ instructions should try to accommodate the special needs of flight crew. 管制员的指令应当尽量满足机组的的特殊需求。
Controllers need to accommodate to the night shift. 管制员需要适应夜班。

story-wing-001.audioText:
AFR123 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff.The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L,but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling.The aircraft overran the runway and crashed.Crew members and 110 passengers were killed,and the co-pilot was badly wounded. According to the investigation,there were three reasons for the accidents.First
of all,the crew didn't use effective methods to verify their position.Secondly,
the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not.Finally, the crew members'idle chatting during the taxi resulted the loss of situation
awareness.

AFR123
story-wing-001.audioTextZh: AFR123在新加坡樟宜机场起飞期间坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组从02L跑道起飞，但机组却在02R跑道对正并开始起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道并坠毁。机组成员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶严重受伤。调查显示，这起事故有三个原因。首先，机组没有采用有效方法确认自己所在的位置。其次，机组忘记检查自己是否位于正确的跑道。最后，机组成员在滑行期间闲聊，导致情景意识丧失。
story-wing-001.referenceText:
同老题9，树袋熊43
必做这45套的音频我还是保持和它原来一样，因为有的故事它有细微改动，而且很多人花钱就是为了这45套必做题，我来给大家做的一模一样。
后面那34套基础题库它是真的懒都懒得改了，音色都一模一样，所以我就用的树袋熊的音频。

story-wing-002.audioText:
An A320 collided with a B737 during taxi.The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage on left wing.Luckily,there were no injuries.
After receiving taxi instruction,the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room.But unfortunately,two aircraft collided together.Both captains reported the collision immediately.Because the
Boeing aircraft was damaged seriously,fuel leakage was reported and fire services were required.Fortunately,the fuel leak didn't develop into fire.The crew of the Boeing
aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes when they were hit.
story-wing-002.audioTextZh: 一架A320在滑行期间与一架B737相撞。B737的右副翼严重受损，而A320的左翼仅轻微受损。幸运的是，没有人员受伤。收到滑行指令后，A320开始从B737右侧通过。A320机长认为有足够空间可以通过，但两架飞机不幸发生碰撞。两位机长立即报告了相撞情况。由于波音飞机受损严重，机组报告发生燃油泄漏并请求消防救援。幸运的是，泄漏的燃油没有起火。波音飞机机组表示，他们被撞时一直设置着停留刹车，停在原地。

story-wing-003.audioText:
A pilot of Air China airline told us an event with landing gear problem.After normal
push-back,start-up and taxi,he requested takeoff.However,he was instructed to
hold short of the runway in order to give way to ACA702 on final.ACA702 declared
emergency because of landing gear problem.ACA702 asked for a low pass.The
controller verified the landing gear was still in up position.Then ACA702 requested a touch and go to jar the jammed gear.Unfortunately,the landing gear still couldn't be extended.So,ACA702 had to make a belly landing on a foamed runway.There were no casualties except some minor injuries.
story-wing-003.audioTextZh:
国航的一名飞行员告诉了我们一起关于起落架问题的事件。在正常的推出、开车和滑行后， 他请求起飞。然而，他被指示在跑道外等待，以便给五边的ACA702让路。不过，ACA702
因为起落架问题宣布进入紧急状态，并且请求低空通场，管制员证实起落架仍在收上位。然 后ACA702 请求飞一个连续起飞去把起落架震动下来。但是，起落架仍然没放下来。因此， ACA702 必须要做一个机腹着陆，并且跑道要铺泡沫。除了一些人员受到轻伤外，没有人员 伤 亡 。

story-wing-004.audioText:
When the pilot initially contacted the tower controller,he was told the Runway Visual Range was 500m.The pilot executed a missed approach because of no contact at
minima.Then,he was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach.In the second
approach,the controller issued landing clearance at outer marker.One minute later,the controller observed the airplane was leaving the glide path on the radar display and
issued missed approach instructions again.There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted a building and crashed.
According to the investigation,the poor visibility made the pilot nervous and he misunderstood the missed approach instructions and made a wrong turn.
(113 words)
story-wing-004.audioTextZh:
当飞行员最初联系塔台管制员时，他被告知跑道视程为500米。由于最低高度跑道不可见，
飞行员执行了复飞。之后，管制员雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。在第二次进近中，管制员 在外指点标处发布了着陆许可。一分钟后，管制员在雷达屏幕上观察到飞机正在偏离下滑道， 所以他再次发出复飞指令。后来再没有收到飞行员的回复。飞机撞上建筑物，坠毁了。
据调查，低能见度让飞行员变得非常紧张，他误解了复飞指令，转弯出现失误。

story-wing-005.audioText:
A Delta Airline aircraft departed from Shanghai to Seoul.It carried 256 passengers
and 13 crew members on board.During takeoff rolling,an unknown foreign object
was sucked into port engine and the engine fire warning light illuminated.Then the flight crew declared an emergency right after airborne and completed the emergency checklist procedure.Through good communication,the controller understood the
flight crew wanted to return to land.But the pilot had to dump fuel before landing because the aircraft was overweight to land.So the controller vectored the aircraft to the dumping area.After circling over the sea and dumping fuel for almost one hour, the plane returned to land safely
(112 words)
story-wing-005.audioTextZh: 达美航空一架飞机从上海飞往首尔。机上载有256名乘客和13名机组人员。在起飞滑跑过程 中，左发吸进不明异物，发动机火警警示灯亮起。随后，机组人员在升空后立即宣布紧急情况， 并完成了紧急检查单程序。通过沟通，管制员了解到机组人员想要返回着陆。但由于飞机超重， 飞行员不得不在降落前放油。所以管制员引导飞机到了放油区。在海上盘旋并放了近一个小 时的油后，飞机安全降落。

story-wing-006.audioText:
The crew of flight 523 found a traffic 20 miles at FL294 right ahead of the airplane on TCAS at FL290 near LAMEN.The captain reported to Shanghai Control immediately, but the controller responded that there was no indication on his radar screen and there had not been any flight advisory.The captain then instructed the crew to turn left and found the conflicting traffic closing to the flight path and a TCAS warning was initiated. The crew then immediately turns right for avoidance,disengage the autopilot and
descended to a lower altitude.The crew reported to the controller about the conflict after the conflict had been cleared.

 523
story-wing-006.audioTextZh: 523号航班在LAMEN附近以FL290飞行时，机组通过TCAS发现飞机正前方20海里处有一架位于FL294的航空器。机长立即向上海管制报告，但管制员回应称，雷达屏幕上没有相关显示，此前也没有收到任何飞行情报。随后，机长指示机组左转，并发现冲突航空器正不断接近本机航迹，TCAS警告随即触发。机组立即右转避让，断开自动驾驶并下降到较低高度。冲突解除后，机组向管制员报告了此次冲突。

story-wing-007.audioText:
An United aircraft experienced an in-flight engine fire during departure climb from
New York City.During the return to the departure airport,the nose landing gear failed to extend,and the flight crew was instructed to execute a go-around,during which
the crew extended the nose gear using the emergency procedure.The flight crew
conducted an emergency landing,and the 2 flight crew members,3 flight attendants, and 138 passengers deplaned on the runway.No occupant injuries were reported,but the airplane sustained substantial damage from the fire.
The NTSB determines that the probable cause of this accident was the inappropriate manual engine-start procedure used by maintenance personnel.
(108 words)
story-wing-007.audioTextZh:
美联航一架飞机，在从纽约起飞爬升时，飞机发动机起火。在返回起飞机场期间，前起落架 未能放出，空管指示机组人员执行复飞，在此期间，机组人员使用紧急程序放下了前起落架。 之后，机组人员执行了紧急降落，2名机组人员、3名空乘人员和138名乘客在跑道上下机。
没有乘客受伤，但飞机在火灾中遭受了重大损失。 美国国家运输安全委员会认为，这起事故的可能原因是维修人员使用了不适当的手动启动引 擎的程序。

story-wing-008.audioText:
A China Southern aircraft lost a left upper wing trailing edge panel during cruise at
FL270.Initially,ATC received a pilot report that the flight crew had experienced "light chop".The flight was en route from Greenyard to Blueyard Airport.The broken panel struck the window of passenger row 19ABC and cracked only the outer portion of the window.Pressurization was not lost.The flight crew continued on to Blueyard.
Upon approach to Blueyard,ATC instructed the flight crew to expedite for separation. the flight crew informed ATC that they could not increase their airspeed due to
possible airframe damage.The flight landed safely.There were 174 passengers and 6 crew members with no reported injuries.
(116 words)
story-wing-008.audioTextZh: 中国南方航空一架飞机在FL270巡航时，左翼上表面的一块后缘面板脱落。最初，空中交通管制收到飞行员报告称，机组当时遭遇了“轻度颠簸”。该航班正从Greenyard机场飞往Blueyard机场。脱落的面板击中了19ABC排乘客的舷窗，仅使舷窗外层开裂，飞机没有失压。机组继续飞往Blueyard机场。飞机进近Blueyard机场时，空中交通管制为建立间隔指示机组加快速度；机组告知管制员，由于机体可能受损，他们无法提高空速。航班最终安全着陆。机上共有174名乘客和6名机组人员，没有人员受伤报告。

story-wing-009.audioText:
An Airbus 320 collided with an ERJ 145 during taxi in the run-up area of runway 19. The right aileron of the ERJ was seriously damaged;the left winglet of the Airbus had minor damage.There were no injuries.
The captain of the Airbus reported that he was positioned to the right of the ERJ.ATC cleared him for departure,which required him to taxi past the ERJ.He stated that he checked the proximity of the ERJ,and it looked like he could clear it and then felt the impact.
The captain notified ATC of the collision.Airport fire crews responded,but there was no fuel leak or fire.
(110 words)
story-wing-009.audioTextZh:
一架空客320在19号跑道的试车区滑行时与一架ERJ145 相撞。ERJ 右副翼严重受损；这架空 客飞机的左小翼有轻微损坏。没有人员伤亡。
空客机长报告说，他的位置在ERJ的右侧。管制允许他们起飞，要求他们滑行通过ERJ。他 说他检查了ERJ的附近区域，看起来空间足够让飞机通过，可是没想到还是撞上了。
机长向管制通报了相撞事件。机场消防人员做出了反应，但没有发生燃油泄漏或火灾。

story-wing-010.audioText:
10.Before the first ILS approach,the pilot was advised that the runway visual range was 600 feet,then he was given a landing clearance.The pilot declared a missed approach and was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach.
After turning inbound on the localizer,the pilot was advised the runway visual range and then cleared to land.When the tower controller observed the airplane turning to the south of the runway,she issued missed approach instructions.
There was no further reply from the pilot.The airplane impacted a tall tree and collided on the ground.
According to the investigation,the pilot misinterpreted the missed approach instructions by making the right turn and then led to the accident.
(119 words)
story-wing-010.audioTextZh:
在第一次盲降进近前，飞行员被告知跑道视距为600英尺，然后他得到了着陆许可。飞行员 宣布复飞，并得到雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。
在转向对准航向道后，飞行员被告知跑道视距，然后获准着陆。塔台管制员观察到飞机转向 跑道南面时，发布了复飞指令。
飞行员没有进一步的答复。飞机撞上了一棵大树，撞向地上。
据调查，飞行员错误理解了复飞指令，右转导致了事故。

story-wing-011.audioText:
11.A Boeing 757 and a Bombardier were seriously damaged when the tails of both
airplanes collided during the pushback.The flight crew of the Bombardier reported
that they were in a stopped position and their ground crew was in the process of
disconnecting the tug.Company maintenance personnel stated they were pushing the 757 back and did not see the Bombardier.
Communication recordings between ground control and both airplanes revealed that the 757 was cleared for pushback from gate 80.Later,the Bombardier was cleared
to push back from gate 79.The ground controller did not advise either aircraft of simultaneous adjacent pushback operations and did not forecast a traffic conflict. (111 words)
story-wing-011.audioTextZh: 一架波音757和一架庞巴迪飞机在推出过程中尾部相撞，两架飞机均严重受损。庞巴迪机组报告称，碰撞发生时，他们的飞机已经停住，地面人员正在断开牵引车。航空公司维修人员表示，他们正将757向后推出，没有看到庞巴迪飞机。地面管制与两架飞机之间的通信录音显示，757获准从80号机位推出；随后，庞巴迪飞机获准从79号机位推出。地面管制员没有向任何一架飞机通报相邻机位同时推出的情况，也没有预见到交通冲突。

story-wing-012.audioText:
12.Air France 551 departed runway 15R and over flew United 83 at Atlantic Airport.The tower controller had cleared United 83 to land on runway 10 when the aircraft was about 6 miles on final approach.
Simultaneously,ATC cleared Air France 551 for takeoff on runway 15R.Air France 551 was on taxiway when the takeoff clearance was issued.The pilots rotated at taxiway and over flew United 83 at the intersection of runways 10 and 15R.United 83 exited runway 10 afterwards.
The main cause of this incident is local controller's failure of maintaining awareness of the situation and failing to provide the appropriate separation between the two aircraft on intersecting runways.
(113 words)
story-wing-012.audioTextZh: 法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞，并在大西洋机场上空飞越美联航83号航班。当美联航83号航班在10号跑道最后进近约6海里处时，塔台管制员已许可其在10号跑道着陆。与此同时，空中交通管制许可法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞。起飞许可发布时，法国航空551号航班位于滑行道上。该航班在滑行道附近抬前轮，并在10号与15R跑道交叉口上方飞越美联航83号航班。随后，美联航83号航班脱离10号跑道。事件的主要原因是本场管制员未能保持情景意识，也未能为在相交跑道上运行的两架飞机提供适当间隔。

story-wing-013.audioText:
The Piper and Cessna pilots were inbound to the same airport.
The Cessna pilot was directed to enter a left downwind,then flew south before turning southwest.
The Piper pilot was also directed to enter a left downwind.
The controller noticed two VFR targets close to one another.Assuming the
target on a southwest heading was a VFR helicopter when it was actually the
Cessna.The controller issued conflict traffic to the southbound aircraft,assuming it was the Cessna pilot when it was actually the Piper pilot,and the Cessna pilot acknowledged the traffic call.Later,the Piper pilot informed the controller of the collision and declared an emergency.
(109 words)
story-wing-013.audioTextZh: 一架派珀和一架塞斯纳都在飞往同一机场。塞斯纳飞行员被指示加入左三边，随后先向南飞行，再转向西南。派珀飞行员也被指示加入左三边。管制员注意到两个目视飞行规则目标彼此接近。他误以为向西南飞行的目标是一架目视飞行规则直升机，而实际上那是塞斯纳；他又向南行航空器通报了冲突交通，以为该航空器是塞斯纳，实际上却是派珀，而塞斯纳飞行员确认收到了这份交通通报。随后，派珀飞行员通知管制员两机已经相撞，并宣布紧急状态。

story-wing-014.audioText:
14.When SIA128 was approaching the airspace of Chicago center area control,
the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1.The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency.However,the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency.Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change,they didn't know that flight 128 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later,the controller at the next sector identified SIA128 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the
company dispatcher,they got no response from the pilots.The controller finally regained contact with SIA128 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
story-wing-014.audioTextZh: 当新航128接近芝加哥中心区管制空域时，管制员指示机组人员将无线电频率调到下一 个扇区132.1。副驾驶确认了频率的变化，并把正确的频率复诵了出来。然而，机组人 员并没有在新的频率上联系到管制员。由于接收的人员正在准备换班，他们不知道128 航班没有建立联系，30分钟后，下一个扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出了新航128。虽然 他们试图通过呼叫公司调度员与飞机建立联系，但没有得到飞行员的回应。50分钟后， 管制员终于通过紧急频率与新航128重新取得了联系。

story-wing-015.audioText:
Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers.One day,a
B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing.It was then cleared to
cross runway 36R.But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R.The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply.He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off.This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R.So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R.Suddenly,the
controller noticed the B757's lights came on and it began to move.Realizing the risk of runway incursion,he canceled A320's takeoff clearance immediately.
story-wing-015.audioTextZh: 着陆灯可以作为信号向管制员发送有用信息。一天，一架B757在降落后经由滑行道A9 脱离36左跑道。随后飞机获准穿越36右跑道。但它在36左和36右跑道之间的A9 滑行 道上停止滑行。塔台管制员试图联系飞行员但没有得到回复。他看到飞机着陆灯也关 闭了。他猜想B757遇无线电故障，没有收到穿越36右跑道的许可，所以他给A320发 布了起飞许可，使用跑道36右。突然，管制员注意到B757 的着陆灯亮了并开始移动。 管制员意识到跑道有被入侵的危险，于是立即取消了A320 的起飞许可。

story-wing-016.audioText:
It was a foggy day,Flight 626 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R.Later,the
ground controller gave start-up clearance to a Cessna pilot.Then he requested Flight 626 to contact Tower controller.From then on,those two aircraft were on two different frequencies.
The Cessna started to taxi,but the pilot entered wrong taxiway.The ground
controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue taxi.At the same

the active runway 36R.Unfortunately,the two aircraft collided,all people on
board died.
(114 words)
story-wing-016.audioTextZh: 那天有雾，626航班获准滑到36R跑道。后来，地面管制员给了塞斯纳飞行员开车许可。 然后他要求626航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，这两架飞机在两个不同的频率上飞行。 塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员进入了错误的滑行道。地面管制员没有意识到这一点， 允许塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员批准626航班起飞。当626航班在跑道上 滑跑时，塞斯纳越过跑道等待标志，进入活动跑道36R。不幸的是，两架飞机相撞，机 上人员全部遇难。

story-wing-017.audioText:
17.The tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22.But he forgot
the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16.After Flight 145 touched down,the ground radar system alerted.The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16.However,the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection.It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff.So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145.The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.There were no
injuries or damage to either aircraft.But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind.
story-wing-017.audioTextZh:
塔台管制员允许145航班降落在22号跑道上。但是当他允许101航班从16号交叉跑道起 飞时，他忘记了即将进场的飞机。145航班着陆后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员
试图指示145航班在16号跑道外停止。然而，飞机只是在跑道交叉口的中间停了下来。 101航班无法中止起飞。所以101航班提前离地飞，从145航班上方飞过。两架飞机只差 50英尺就撞上了。两架飞机都没有人员伤亡或损坏。但这被认为是这类事件中最严重 的一次。

story-wing-018.audioText:
When an Flight 815 was approaching the terminal area of its destination,the
flight crew contacted the Approach and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Because of the tailwind conditions,the controller advised the pilot to make a
circling approach for runway 30.But the flight crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on that runway.The runway was wet and the braking action was not good.
During landing,the aircraft skidded to the right side of the runway.The fuselage was broken into three pieces,the right engine and right main gear were
separated from the aircraft.No one was killed,but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
story-wing-018.audioTextZh:
当815航班接近目的地终端区时，机组人员联系进近，要求盲降进近12号跑道。由于顺 风，管制员建议飞行员在30号跑道作盘旋进近。但是机组人员坚持降落在12号跑道上， 管制员允许他们降落在那条跑道上。跑道很湿，刹车效果也不好。
在着陆时，飞机滑到跑道的右侧。机身断成三块，右发动机和右主起落架与飞机分离。 没有人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

story-wing-019.audioText:
Flight 456 with 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to land at Tokyo Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach,the pilot was
instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion.During the
holding,the pilot was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested the crew to divert to the alternate,but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough.So the controller vectored the crew to land at
runway 34R.
Unfortunately,the pilot couldn't stabilize on the localizers due wind shear.The aircraft went around and made a second approach.Later,it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage.
story-wing-019.audioTextZh: 456号航班载有152名乘客和9名机组人员，正在飞往东京机场着陆。当该航班从东京区调移交给东京进近时，由于空中交通拥堵，飞行员被指示飞往DA点等待。在等待期间，飞行员获悉当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议机组备降，但飞行员报告剩余燃油不足。因此，管制员对机组实施雷达引导，使其在34R跑道着陆。遗憾的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在航向道上稳定下来。飞机复飞后进行了第二次进近。随后，飞机因燃油不足撞上山坡。

story-wing-020.audioText:
A Boeing 747 performed the flight from Taiwan to Hongkong carrying 206
passengers and 19 crew members on board.It broke up and crashed,killing all
those on board.It is the deadliest air disaster in Taiwan.
After careful investigation,scientists found the full story of the crash.About 20 years ago,the plane landed heavily and damaged the skin on its tail.Instead of replacing the whole skin in accordance with the maintenance guidelines,
the airlines only covered the area with a piece of aluminum plate and painted it.This cause a buildup of metal fatigue in the area.For the following 22 years, maintenance crews had not noticed anything unusual.
story-wing-020.audioTextZh:
一架波音747从台湾飞往香港，机上载有206名乘客和19名机组人员。飞机解体坠毁， 机上人员全部遇难。这是台湾最严重的空难。
经过仔细调查，科学家们发现了坠机的全部经过。大约20年前，这架飞机遭遇重着陆， 机身蒙皮受损。航空公司没有按照维护指南更换整个蒙皮，而是只用一块铝板覆盖了 该区域并进行了喷漆。这导致该区域的金属疲劳。在接下来的22年里，维修人员没有 注意到任何异常。

story-wing-021.audioText:
Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport,also known as Jiuzhaigou Airport,is an airport in
Songpan County,Sichuan province.It is one of the highest airport in the world with an altitude of 3448 meters.There are breathtaking mountain ranges on
both sides of the axis of the runway,and the highest Xuebao peak is the main
peak of Minshan Mountain,more than 18000 feet above the sea level.The terrain is complex and wind changes rapidly near the airport.So it is considered one of the most difficult airports to fly to in China.But those who fly over here are also amazed by the beautiful scenery.Due to the high elevation,some passengers
may experience symptoms of altitude sickness.
story-wing-021.audioTextZh: 九寨黄龙机场，又被称为九寨沟机场，是四川省松潘县的一个机场。它是世界上海拔 最高的机场之一，海拔3448米。跑道轴线两侧有令人惊叹的山脉，最高的雪豹峰是岷 山的主峰，海拔超过18000英尺。机场附近地形复杂，风的变化迅速，所以它被认为 是中国最难飞到的机场之一，但那些飞到这里的人也会被美丽的风景惊艳到。由于海 拔高，一些乘客可能会出现高原反应的症状。

story-wing-022.audioText:
A Pakistan flight reported the failure of the left hand engine.The crew shut the engine down and continued descending,some time later,they declared Mayday and shortly afterwards radio and radar contact was lost.The aircraft was unable to maintain heading and turned left before impact with the ground.And all
occupants of the aircraft perished in the crash.
The investigation into the crash showed that the accident was caused by
technical factors and was not caused by human error.The flight crew faced an
very complex technical error,that had never occurred before.Due to maintenance irregularities,a turbine blade fractured causing further damage,that made it
impossible to control the aircraft.
story-wing-022.audioTextZh: 一架巴基斯坦航班报告左发动机失效。机组关闭该发动机并继续下降；一段时间后，他们宣布MAYDAY，不久后无线电和雷达联系中断。飞机无法保持航向，在撞击地面前向左转弯，机上所有人员均在坠机事故中遇难。事故调查显示，事故由技术因素造成，并非人为错误。飞行机组面对的是一种此前从未发生过的、非常复杂的技术故障。由于维修不规范，一片涡轮叶片断裂并造成进一步损坏，使飞机最终无法操纵。

story-wing-023.audioText:
A Boeing 747 was on final approach to runway 26.After the aircraft went around from very low height,it did not climb out to safety altitude and impacted terrain about 1100 meters past the runway.
The cause of the accident was the missing control of the crew over the aircraft
position in relation to the glide slope during the automatic approach.The flight was conducted at night in the weather conditions,which is suitable for ICAO
CAT II landing.And as a result,the go-around was not taken in due time and the aircraft had a significant deviation from the established approach chart,which led to the controlled flight into terrain.
story-wing-023.audioTextZh: 一架波音747正在对26号跑道实施最后进近。飞机从极低高度复飞后，未能爬升至安全高度，并在越过跑道约1100米处撞地。事故原因是，在自动进近过程中，机组未能监控飞机相对于下滑道的位置。航班在夜间飞行，当时的天气条件适用于ICAO II类（CAT II）着陆。结果，机组没有及时复飞，且飞机严重偏离规定的进近航图，最终导致可控飞行撞地。

story-wing-024.audioText:
A Cargo Boeing 747 with 7 crew and cargo of military vehicles,has crashed shortly after takeoff.
Afghan Authorities immediately denied claims that the crash was the result of
enemy activities.Several observers on the ground reported the aircraft had
just lifted off and was climbing through approximately 1200 feet when it's nose
sharply rose.The aircraft appeared to have stalled and came down.According to a listener on frequency,the crew reported the aircraft stalled due to a possible load shift.
The NTSB determined that the probable cause of this accident was inadequate procedures for restraining special cargo loads.The cargo moved after and
damaged hydraulic systems and horizontal stabilizer components.
story-wing-024.audioTextZh: 一架载有7名机组人员、装载军用车辆的波音747货机在起飞后不久坠毁。阿富汗当局立即否认坠机由敌对活动造成。多名地面目击者报告称，飞机刚刚离地，爬升通过大约1200英尺时，机头突然急剧上仰。飞机似乎发生失速，随后坠落。据一名监听该频率的人称，机组报告飞机可能因载荷移位而失速。美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）认定，这起事故的可能原因是特殊货物载荷的系留程序不充分。货物随后发生移动，损坏了液压系统和水平安定面部件。

story-wing-025.audioText:
Flight 60 encountered moderate turbulence at 9000 feet during descending to Dallas.
According to NTSB,as the flight began its descent,the captain illuminated the seat belt sign and made a public address reminding passengers to buckle up.
Then the airplane entered a band of small cumulus clouds and experienced 10-15 seconds of moderate turbulence.The flight attendants were conducting their
final cabin safety checks then,so 7 flight attendants received minor injuries,one passenger,who ignored the seat-belt sign and instructions,injured his left ankle. The aircraft continued for a landing on Dallas without further incident.The
flight crew requested paramedics to meet the airplane at the gate.Finally,the passenger was transported to the hospital.

60
story-wing-025.audioTextZh: 60号航班在下降前往达拉斯期间，于9000英尺遭遇中度颠簸。据美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）称，飞机开始下降时，机长点亮安全带指示灯，并通过客舱广播提醒乘客系好安全带。随后，飞机进入一片小积云带，经历了10至15秒的中度颠簸。当时，乘务员正在进行最后的客舱安全检查，因此7名乘务员轻伤；另有一名无视安全带指示灯和相关指示的乘客左脚踝受伤。飞机继续飞往达拉斯并安全着陆，未再发生其他事件。飞行机组请求急救人员在登机口接机，最终该名乘客被送往医院。

story-wing-026.audioText:
A flight with 98 passengers,encountered smoke in cockpit shortly after departure.
The aircraft was cleared to FL340 and was about to contact Area Control when

The crew declared an emergency,then the captain elected to hand over pilot
flying duties to the first officer in order to give his attention to the overall
management of the situation.Both pilots put on their oxygen masks,and begun the descent and preparations to evacuate the aircraft on the runway.Finally
the aircraft landed safely.6 injured passengers received medical assistance after landing.
story-wing-026.audioTextZh:
一架载有98名乘客的航班在起飞后不久，驾驶舱出现烟雾。
这架飞机被允许飞往高度层340,正要与区域管制中心联系时，驾驶舱机组人员闻到了 烟味。经过一番讨论，他们决定返回出发机场。
机组人员宣布了紧急情况，然后机长选择将飞行员的飞行职责交给副驾驶，以便让他 关注局势的整体管理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降，准备在跑道上撤离。 最后飞机安全着陆了。6名受伤乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

story-wing-027.audioText:
An Airbus with 146 passengers and 5 crew,encountered turbulence during climbing from FL320 to FL340,causing injuries to 24 passengers and 3 cabin creW.
The aircraft diverted for a safe landing on runway 32 about 25 minutes after
stopping the climb at FL334.The 27 injured were taken to a hospital.Passengers reported those not belted into their seats were lifted against the ceiling and then slammed down again.A number of cabin ceiling panels received cracks.
A replacement A320 was dispatched and reached the final destination with a
delay of 7.5 hours.According to NTSB,probable cause of the occurrence was an inadvertent encounter with convective turbulence while in cruise flight.
story-wing-027.audioTextZh: 一架空客飞机载有146名乘客和5名机组人员，在从FL320爬升至FL340期间遭遇颠簸，造成24名乘客和3名客舱机组人员受伤。飞机在FL334停止爬升约25分钟后备降，并在32号跑道安全着陆。27名伤者被送往医院。乘客报告称，没有系好安全带的人先被抛向客舱顶部，随后又重重摔下，多块客舱顶板出现裂纹。航空公司调派了一架替代A320，该机最终比原计划晚7.5小时到达目的地。美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）认为，这起事件的可能原因是飞机巡航期间意外遭遇对流性颠簸。

story-wing-028.audioText:
Flight 08 was cleared to climb to and maintain FL220.At the same time,another flight 29 was enroute at FL240.ATC instructed flight 08 to turn left heading
270.The crew however,read back "Climb FL270",which was not picked up by ATC.The crew selected FL270 into their Selected Altitude.The aircraft began
to climb.Later,the radar issued an alert between these two aircraft.Then
ATC instructed flight 08 to descend back to FL220 immediately.The aircraft
already climbed through FL236.The separation reduced to O feet vertically and 2.6nm horizontally and the aircraft continued to climb reaching FL250,and
re-establishing vertical separation.ATC thus instructed 08 to continue the climb to FL260.

08
story-wing-028.audioTextZh: 航班被许可爬升并保持高度层220。与此同时，另一架29号航班在高度层240巡航。 空中交通管制中心指示08航班左转航向270。然而，机组人员复诵成“上高度层270”, 空管也没有注意到。机组人员将FL270 选择到他们的“选择高度”。飞机开始爬升。后来， 雷达在这两架飞机之间发出了警报。然后ATC 指示08航班立即下降到高度220,飞机已 经爬升到高度236。垂直距离降至0英尺，水平距离降至2.6海里，飞机继续爬升至高度 层250,并重新建立垂直间隔。空管因此指示08航班继续爬升到高度层260。

story-wing-029.audioText:
A flight was on NDB approach to runway 28 in instrument meteorological
conditions.The aircraft descended below minimum safe altitude when it was

go-around and the aircraft climbed to safe altitude.Then the crew positioned
for another approach and landed safely on runway 28 after aborting the first
approach.
According to the investigation,the incident occurred while the aircraft performed an NDB approach without DME,probably without external visual references.
Meanwhile,the first preparation of the approach was probably incomplete or imprecise.
story-wing-029.audioTextZh:
在仪表气象条件下，一架飞机在NDB 进近28号跑道。当飞机被移交给塔台时，它下降 到最低安全高度以下。进场管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的EGPWS也发出了 警告。机组人员启动复飞，飞机爬升到安全高度。然后机组人员准备再次进近，在第 一次复飞后安全降落在28号跑道上。
根据调查，事故发生时，飞机在没有DME 的情况下进行了NDB 进近，可能没有外部视 觉参考。同时，该进近的最初准备工作可能不完整或不精确。

story-wing-030.audioText:
An A320 with 114 passengers and 6 crew,departed from the runway.At that
time,the left engine dropped two bonnets.In the absence of any abnormal
indications and unaware of the separation,the crew continued the flight for a
safe landing.Although a part of the engine cowling became stuck in the left main gear,the gear retracted normally after takeoff and extended without problems. The aircraft received minor damage at the left main gear and the left side of
the fuselage,however all persons on board disembarked normally,no medical attention was needed.
The investigation has determined that the incident was caused by flying the airplane without closing and properly latching the cowls on the airplane's left engine.
story-wing-030.audioTextZh: 一架载有114名乘客和6名机组人员的A320 飞机从跑道起飞。当时，左发动机掉了两个 发动机盖。机组没有注意到任何异常指示，也不知道发生了发动机罩脱落，继续飞行 安全着陆。虽然发动机整流罩的一部分卡在左主起落架上，但起飞后起落架收放正常， 释出无问题。飞机的左主起落架和机身左侧受到轻微损坏，但机上所有人员正常下机， 没有人需要医疗救助。调查确定，该事件是由于起飞时没有关闭并正确闩上飞机左发 的整流罩。

story-wing-031.audioText:
QFA67 had safely landed on runway 03,vacated the runway via taxiway but
taxied past the holding point of runway 06 and crossed an illuminated stop bar without ATC clearance.
Another QFA82 was accelerating for takeoff from runway 06 when QFA67 crossed the hold short line.QFA67 became aware of their position and stopped their
aircraft just before crossing the edge of runway 06.Then QFA82 rejected takeoff and came to a stop.The aircraft vacated the runway and returned to the apron. QFA82's wingtip passing about 15 meters from QFA67's nose at low speed.
The ATSB report that bad taxiway design,flight crew distraction and incorrect mental model is responsible for this runway incursion.

QFA67
story-wing-031.audioTextZh: QFA67安全降落在03号跑道，经滑行道脱离跑道后，在未获得空中交通管制许可的情况下滑过06号跑道等待点，并越过亮起的停止排灯。QFA67越过跑道等待线时，另一架QFA82正在06号跑道加速起飞。QFA67意识到自身位置后，在即将越过06号跑道边缘前停住。随后，QFA82中断起飞并停下，之后脱离跑道返回停机坪。低速状态下，QFA82的翼尖从距QFA67机头约15米处经过。澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）报告称，滑行道设计不佳、飞行机组注意力分散以及错误的心理模型共同导致了这起跑道侵入事件。

story-wing-032.audioText:
A B747 performing freight with 2 crew,was on a GPS/RNAV approach to A
Airport runway 19L,but unintentionally landed on runway 18 of B Airport.The
crew requested to vacate via taxiway D,the puzzled tower responded "stand by", then informed the crew that they were about 8nm from the original airport.The crew believed they had landed on A Airport,the even more puzzled tower replied "confirm you landed at A Airport?".Because the tower of A airport was closed
at that time,the crew contacted A airport by UNICOM frequency.After which, the crew realized that they have landed on the wrong airport.In the meantime a ground person arrived at the aircraft and told the crew the local frequency.
story-wing-032.audioTextZh:
一架载有2名机组人员的B747 飞机，GPS/RNAV 进近下降着陆A机场的19L跑道，但
无意中降落在B机场的18跑道上。机组人员请求从D滑行道脱离，塔台困惑地回答“稍 等",然后通知机组人员他们距离原机场约8海里。机组人员认为他们已经降落在A机
场，塔台更困惑的回答："证实你降落在A机场?"由于当时A机场塔台关闭，机组人员通 过UNICOM 频率联系A 机场。之后，机组人员意识到他们降落在了错误的机场。与此同时， 一名地勤人员来到飞机上，告知了机组人员本场的频率。

story-wing-033.audioText:
An ERJ was cleared self-positioning for an ILS approach.At the same time,an
ultralight aircraft was operating VFR flight below the controlled airspace.The two aircraft were on different radio frequencies.
While positioning to intercept the localizer,the ERJ automatically turned west and began to descend.Then the crew changed from automatic glideslope
coupling to vertical speed and increased the rate of descent to re-capture the glideslope.
Later,the crew queried about the target on their TCAS and the altitude of the ultralight aircraft.When their distance reduced to 1 nautical mile horizontally and 200 feet vertically,the ERJ's TCAS issued a resolution advisory,and the crew
initiated a go around.The aircraft made another approach and landed safely.
story-wing-033.audioTextZh: 一架ERJ获准自行定位实施ILS进近。与此同时，一架超轻型飞机正在管制空域下方按照目视飞行规则运行，两架飞机使用不同的无线电频率。ERJ在定位切入航向道时自动向西转弯并开始下降。随后，机组从自动耦合下滑道改为使用垂直速度方式，并增大下降率以重新截获下滑道。之后，机组询问TCAS上的目标及超轻型飞机的高度。当两机间隔缩小至水平1海里、垂直200英尺时，ERJ的TCAS发布决断咨询（RA），机组随即复飞。飞机随后重新进近并安全着陆。

story-wing-034.audioText:
An A319 with 148 passengers and 6 crew,was descending when the first officer, pilot flying,became unfit to fly,relinquished control to the captain and left the cockpit.The captain declared PANPAN and continued for a safe landing.
The probable cause of the incident was that the co-pilot experienced anxiety
which developed into an anxiety attack during the approach.The captain,ATC and cabin crew worked together effectively to achieve a safe single pilot landing and to get medical help for the co-pilot.
If the co-pilot reported that he is unfit for duty,and if there were more effective communication between the co-pilot and the captain,the opportunity for the incident might had been reduced.
story-wing-034.audioTextZh: 一架A319载有148名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机下降过程中，担任操纵飞行员的副驾驶身体状况变得不适合继续飞行，于是将操纵权交给机长并离开驾驶舱。机长宣布PAN PAN，并继续飞行，最终安全着陆。事件的可能原因是副驾驶在进近期间感到焦虑，随后发展为焦虑发作。机长、空中交通管制和客舱机组有效协作，使飞机由单名飞行员安全着陆，并让副驾驶获得医疗救助。如果副驾驶能够更早报告自己不适合执勤，并且副驾驶与机长之间的沟通更加有效，这起事件发生的可能性或许会降低。

story-wing-035.audioText:
An AirAsia Airbus 330-300,with 359 people on board,was enroute at FL380
about 200 nautical mile southwest of Perth.Then the left hand engine suffered a blade fracture.the engine ingested the blade and caused severe damage in engine core and severe vibrations.The crew shut the engine down,and drifted the aircraft down to FL200,and returned to Perth for a safe landing about 2
hours after the engine failure.
Passengers reported they heard a large bang,followed by severe vibrations,
and sounds like a spinning washing machine.They were instructed to brace for landing.
Australia's emergency services reported,they put their marine emergency services on standby for a possible water landing.
The airline reported the aircraft returned to Perth due to a technical problem, but they didn't confirm it is an engine issue.Emergency services were called as precaution only as part of the standard operating procedures.The passengers then rebooked onto other flights.
story-wing-035.audioTextZh: 一架载有359人的亚航(AirAsia)空客330-300客机，当时正在珀斯西南约200海里的高 度层380飞行。随即左发风扇叶片断裂。发动机吸入叶片，造成发动机核心部件严重损 伤，发动机振动严重。机组人员关闭发动机，将飞机降至高度层200,在发动机故障约 2小时后返回珀斯安全着陆。乘客们报告说，他们听到了一声巨响，接着是剧烈的震动， 听起来像洗衣机在旋转。他们被要求做好着陆防撞准备。澳大利亚应急服务部门报告称， 他们已通知海上应急服务处于待命状态，以应对潜在的水上迫降。该航空公司报告称， 飞机返航珀斯是由于技术问题，但他们没有证实是发动机问题。请求紧急服务只是作 为预防措施的一部分，作为标准操作程序的一个环节。随后，这些乘客重新预订了其 他航班。
story-wing-035.referenceText: 树袋熊96，飞翅的音频有问题，大家可以听听，上面的音频已经换成树袋熊的了

story-wing-036.audioText:
An Eastar Jet B737 performing flight from Korea to Japan,was cleared for the
approach to runway 03L.however,the aircraft was aligned with runway 03R.but the runway 03R was occupied by a vehicle.The aircraft went around from very low height.Then it positioned for another approach to runway 03L.Finally,the aircraft landed safely on runway 03L about 9 minutes after the go around.
JTSB reported that the aircraft didn't land on the right runway as instructed by ATC.In this serious incident,it is highly probable that because the captain of the aircraft misidentified the runway.he made an approach for the different runway where an inspection vehicle was running on.
story-wing-036.audioTextZh: 一架易斯达航空B737执行从韩国飞往日本的航班，获准进近03L跑道。然而，飞机却对正了03R跑道，而03R跑道上当时有一辆车辆。飞机从极低高度复飞，随后重新定位，对03L跑道实施另一次进近。最终，飞机在复飞约9分钟后安全降落在03L跑道。日本运输安全委员会报告称，该机没有按照空中交通管制指令进近正确的跑道。在这起严重事件中，机长很可能错误识别了跑道，从而进近了另一条正有检查车辆运行的跑道。

story-wing-037.audioText:
An Air France aircraft performs flight from London to Paris with 136 people on
board.When the aircraft was climbing through FL230,the crew donned their
oxygen masks,declared Mayday and requested an immediate return to London. The crew advised they suspected a fire on board,and then,they reported they had smoke and fumes in the cockpit.The aircraft landed safely back on runway
13R about 23 minutes after departure.The crew advised they were able to vacate the runway.Finally,the aircraft taxied to the apron.
The aircraft was able to depart about 4 hours after landing,and reached Paris
with a delay of 4.5 hours.Maintenance identified a faulty display as source of the fumes and smoke.
story-wing-037.audioTextZh:
一架法航飞机从伦敦飞往巴黎，机上有136人。当飞机爬升到高度层230时，机组人员 戴上氧气面罩，宣布遇险，请求立即返回伦敦。机组人员说他们怀疑飞机上着火了，
然后他们报告说驾驶舱里有烟雾。飞机在起飞约23分钟后安全降落在13R跑道上。机组 人员通知他们可以脱离跑道。最后，飞机滑行到停机坪上。
这架飞机在降落后约4小时起飞，在延误4.5小时后抵达巴黎。维修人员发现一个有故 障的显示器是烟雾的来源。

story-wing-038.audioText:
A flight from Philippines to Singapore with 129 people on board,was descending towards Singapore when the flight crew donned their oxygen masks.declared
PAN PAN,reporting excessive cabin altitude and initiated an emergency descent to 9000 feet.The aircraft continued to Singapore for a safe landing on runway 20C.
The likely cause of the excessive cabin altitude was a corruption of LFE that is landing field elevation,in the CPC.The CPC manufacturer believed that the
corruption arose from a fatigue solder joint on the CPC circuit board.There had been past occurrences of excessive cabin altitude,of which one was determined to have been caused by a fatigue solder joint,similar to this occurrence.
story-wing-038.audioTextZh: 一架载有129人的航班从菲律宾飞往新加坡。飞机向新加坡下降时，飞行机组戴上氧气面罩，宣布PAN PAN，报告座舱高度过高，并开始紧急下降至9000英尺。飞机随后继续飞往新加坡，并在20C跑道安全着陆。座舱高度过高的可能原因，是座舱压力控制器（CPC）中的着陆机场标高（LFE）数据发生错误。CPC制造商认为，该错误源于CPC电路板上的疲劳焊点。过去曾发生过多起座舱高度过高事件，其中一起被确定由与本次事件类似的疲劳焊点引起。

story-wing-039.audioText:
A British aircraft pushed back using a towbarless tractor at London Heathrow
Airport.But that unit was disconnected from the aircraft.After receiving taxi
clearance from ATC,the aircraft started moving under its own power and,shortly afterwards,collided with the tractor that had just performed the pushback.Both the right engine of the aircraft and the tractor were damaged.
The investigation report stated,that the primary causal factor was the headset
operator giving the "all clear"signal to the flight crew,before the tractor had
been repositioned to a safe distance.Contributory factors were the co-pilot failing to see the tractor and the tractor not driving away after the aircraft began to taxi.
story-wing-039.audioTextZh: 一架英国航空公司的飞机在伦敦希思罗机场使用无拖杆牵引车推出，推出后牵引车与飞机断开。收到空中交通管制的滑行许可后，飞机依靠自身动力开始移动，不久便与刚刚执行完推出任务的牵引车相撞。飞机右发动机和牵引车均受损。调查报告指出，主要原因是耳机操作员在牵引车尚未移至安全距离前，便向飞行机组发出了“前方净空”信号。促成事件的其他因素包括副驾驶未能看到牵引车，以及飞机开始滑行后牵引车没有及时驶离。

story-wing-040.audioText:
An ERJ190 from Durango to Mexico rejected takeoff from Durango's runway 03 because of adverse weather.The aircraft overran the end of the runway and burst into flames and was destroyed,there were no fatalities,2 people received serious injuries and 83 people received minor injuries.Some people with injuries were
taken to a local hospital.
The airline stated there were 99 passengers on board.The aircraft had operated since 2014.The local governor reported the aircraft was about to take off when it suffered an accident.According to flight data recorder as well as cockpit voice recorder,the pilots did a good job to bring the plane down,which prevented
things from worse to catastrophe.
story-wing-040.audioTextZh:
一架从杜兰戈飞往墨西哥的ERJ190 由于恶劣天气从杜兰戈03号跑道中断起飞。飞机冲 出跑道，起火烧毁，没有人员死亡，2人受重伤，83人受轻伤。一些受伤的人被送往当 地医院。
航空公司称机上有99名乘客。这架飞机自2014年以来一直在运营。当地州长报告说， 飞机在即将起飞时发生了事故。从飞行数据记录仪和驾驶舱语音记录仪来看，飞行员 已经尽全力将飞机停下，避免了事故变成灾难。

story-wing-041.audioText:
A flight from New York to Paris was enroute at FL380 when the crew decided to
divert,reporting with left hand engine failure.The crew requested to descend to
FL320.The diversion was approved,however,the request to descent took more
than 15 minutes due to traffic.The aircraft continued to maintain FL380 in the
meantime.Finally,the aircraft descended to FL290 and landed safely about 2
hours later.Another aircraft was sent to fly the 96 passengers and cargo to Paris.
According to the investigation,the crew attempted to move the thrust lever
back and forth when the engine started to vibrate,but this resulted in the engine
stalling.The crew thus declared emergency and diverted.
story-wing-041.audioTextZh:
一架从纽约飞往巴黎的航班在FL380 飞行途中，机组人员决定备降，报告左发故障。
机组要求下降到高度层320。备降被批准，然而，由于其他航空器，请求下降花了15多 分钟。在此期间，飞机继续保持高度层380。最后，飞机下降到高度层290,并在大约 2小时后安全着陆。另一架飞机将96名乘客和货物送往巴黎。
根据调查，当发动机开始振动时，机组人员试图前后移动推力杆，但这导致了发动机 失速。机组人员因此宣布紧急情况并备降。

story-wing-042.audioText:
A visual approach is an ATC authorization for aircraft on IFR flight plan to proceed visually to the airport,even to the landing.It is not an instrument approach
procedure,and there is no missed approach segment.Even when an aircraft is being vectored for an instrument approach,controllers may initiate or pilots may request a visual approach if the pilot reports the airport or runway in sight.
Before clearing an aircraft for a visual approach,controllers should ensure that weather conditions at the airport are VFR,and they need to resolve potential conflicts with all other aircraft.The pilot must have either the airport or the preceding aircraft in sight.This approach must be authorized and under ATC facility.
story-wing-042.audioTextZh:
目视进近是管制员对原本执行仪表飞行的飞机，计划进行目视进近，甚至到着陆的授权。 它不是仪表进近程序，没有复飞环节。即使航空器处于仪表进近，只要飞行员随后报 告能够目视机场或跑道，管制员就可以发布或者飞行员就可以请求目视进近。
在允许一架飞机进行目视进近之前，管制员应确保机场的天气符合目视飞行条件，并 解决与所有其他飞机的潜在冲突。飞行员必须在任何时候都能看见机场或前机。目视 进近的批准和实施，需要借助空中交通管制设施。

story-wing-043.audioText:
A British Airways aircraft was from London to Paris.20 minutes into the flight,a passenger reported an "acrid burning smell"from seat 12A,fearing the plane was on fire,and alerted crew members.The crew conducted an immediate inspection of the seating area,but did not find any source of the burning smell.Shortly after, the smoke in the cabin was getting thicker and some passengers were having
difficulty breathing.The captain had sent the "Pan-Pan"emergency signal to the control center,requesting an immediate diversion to the nearby airport!However, the smoke turned worse,the plane lost control and crashed 15 nm away from the alternate airport.
story-wing-043.audioTextZh: 一架英国航空公司的飞机从伦敦飞往巴黎，起飞20分钟后，一名乘客报告说，12A 座 位上有“辛辣的烧焦味”,他担心飞机着火了，于是通知了机组人员。机组人员立即对 座位区进行了检查，但没有发现任何燃烧气味的来源。不久之后，机舱内的烟雾越来 越浓，一些乘客呼吸困难。机长向管制中心发出了"Pan-Pan" 紧急信号，要求立即备 降到附近的机场!但是，由于浓烟越来越大，飞机失去控制，在距离备降机场15海里 处坠毁。
story-wing-043.referenceText: 和树袋熊09很像，结局不同，那边顺利撤离，这边坠毁

story-wing-044.audioText:
A B767 suffered tail strike during takeoff.During the takeoff roll,the V1 call was delayed by about 10-15 knots by the captain,as he thought the aircraft might be heavier than calculated.During the rotation the TAILSKID message illuminated, indicating that the aircraft had suffered a tail strike.The captain applied full power and shortly afterwards the stick shaker activated briefly.The aircraft continued to climb away.
